every fact on this page is publicly on the record and sourced. where someone told their own story, we use their words instead of ours. no filler, no press-release copy.

this page is a work in progress. 360 of 686 profiles are written so far, and every fact on them was checked against a source before it went up. even so, sources contradict each other more often than you would think, and some of what we hold is simply out of date. if we got something wrong about you or your music, tell us and we will fix it fast. groovesmaxxing@gmail.com or @groovesmaxxing.

Mau P

🚧 bumpy amsterdam tech house

Maurits Westveen spent years making big-room edm under a different name. then the world shut down, he rebuilt from scratch, and came back as Mau P with a record about drugs from amsterdam that went straight to number one on beatport.

the students now became the teacher.

on the switch, 2022

both parents were musicians. his father a saxophonist, conductor and arranger, his mother a singer. his dad died when he was eighteen. he still makes records in his father's studio.

what followed: "Metro" with Kevin de Vries on Afterlife, the most-played track at tomorrowland in 2023. a residency at the Wynn in vegas. baddest behaviour, his own show, past 25,000 people across sold-out 2024 dates and now a second straight run of wednesdays at Pacha Ibiza. dj mag top 100 at 91 in 2024, then 77 in 2025.

for 2026 he has promised an album, a label and a clothing line. none of it is out yet.

from
amsterdam, netherlands
broke through
"Drugs From Amsterdam," august 2022, Repopulate Mars. number one on beatport overall

Michael Bibi

🚧 bumpy london tech house

london, wimbledon specifically. his father is Robin Bibi, a blues guitarist who has played with Robert Plant and Ben E. King, so the music was in the house long before it was a job.

he co-founded Solid Grooves Records with PAWSA in 2015, though the party had been running a couple of years by then. "Hanging Tree" on Repopulate Mars in 2018 is the one that broke him wide. tech house at the dj awards in ibiza the year after. then SG Raw, then ISOLAT, then ISOLATE, his own all-night concept that came out of a meditation retreat in jamaica.

in may 2023 he was diagnosed with CNS lymphoma. he told everyone himself, the same week.

I don't know what lies ahead, I'm tired but I know I am strong & I won't let this beat me.

5 june 2023

four months later he walked into DC-10 for the solid grooves closing party and played a surprise set, days after finishing his main treatment.

When I first came into hospital I was barely able to walk. Today I walk out with a smile having completed my main treatment.

28 september 2023

he announced remission that december. in april 2024 he played coachella at sunset. that july he filled a 45,000-capacity show at finsbury park and called it One Life, for the city that raised him and treated him, then gave £124,832 of it to the royal marsden cancer charity. he did it again in 2025 and gave another £113,943. at his two-year scans in november 2025 he was still in remission.

Today was a good day. Thank you everyone that helped get us here and danced along the way.

14 november 2025

his line for all of it is one life, live it. that one is his, not ours.

from
london, united kingdom
broke through
"Hanging Tree," november 2018, Repopulate Mars
runs

raised

PAWSA

🚧 bumpy london tech house

David Esekhile, london. his father is nigerian, his mother is irish, and they met at a cinema in the city he still works out of. he sent a demo to Leftwing : Kody, who signed it on the spot, and the four-track "Pilot" ep landed on Lost Records in february 2014.

You can create an imaginary world if you become an artist: that's why I chose to make music as PAWSA, not David Esekhile.

dj mag, undated

a year later he co-founded Solid Grooves Records with Michael Bibi, two names up this page. dj mag gave it best label at the best of british awards in 2023. PAWZ came in 2017 for the records that did not fit, and he co-runs GOLFOS TRAXX with Dennis Cruz.

2024 is when the numbers went strange. "PICK UP THE PHONE" with Nate Dogg, then "TOO COOL TO BE CARELESS", both on his own PAWZ. his rework of "Dirty Cash (Money Talks)" now sits past 257 million plays on spotify.

For me, a label is about curation and creating a home for work that fits a certain standard and a certain identity. A label should feel like a language, not just a release schedule.

nylon, 9 april 2026

august 2025 he took over gunnersbury park for a full day and called it pawsa in the park, his biggest uk show at the time. he entered the dj mag top 100 at 69 that october, his first time on it. february 2026 he headlined alexandra palace. he took pawsa in the park to amsterdam in july.

Solomun

either lane hamburg melodic house + techno

Mladen Solomun was born in travnik in 1975, in what was then yugoslavia, and grew up in hamburg after his family moved. germany offered him a place on the under-16 football team. he turned it down to play for the country he was born in.

the record that took him worldwide was a remix. Noir & Haze, "Around", on Noir Music in 2011. fifteen years later it is still his second most-played track on spotify, past 66 million.

he co-founded Diynamic with Adriano Trolio in hamburg, and the label turns twenty in 2026. then 2DIY4 in 2010 for the stranger material, NINL for his 2021 album, and Love Recycled in june 2025, built entirely around reworking old records.

I know from personal experience that 60-90 minutes is not enough to really take the audience on a journey

rolling stone uk, 3 october 2024

which is the whole point of him. Solomun +1 at Pacha Ibiza runs nineteen sundays in 2026, his twelfth straight year, and he plays five of them alone all night. march brought "Kinesphere" on Diynamic. july brought "Rumpta", his first record with Skrillex.

in june he opened Pacha New York for free, and gave the tickets to people who had come to his fish market show in the bronx.

I held that rule for over ten years. I never questioned it. Once the summer starts, I stay in Europe.

on breaking it, june 2026

he sat out both coachella weekends this april after surgery on his left ear, and told everyone himself rather than let it be a rumour.

The doctor says everything went well, so in the near future I'll most likely hear just as well or just as badly as before.

19 march 2026

Vintage Culture

either lane são paulo house

Lukas Ruiz, born in mundo novo, out on the border between brazil and paraguay. he was studying law in maringá. he taught himself to produce instead.

The internet was my school.

dj mag, 15 march 2022

an unofficial rework of pink floyd's "Another Brick In The Wall" went up on soundcloud around 2014 and did close to twenty million views on youtube. six years later "It Is What It Is" with Elise LeGrow on Defected gave him his first number one on the overall beatport chart. his remix of Maverick Sabre and Jorja Smith's "Slow Down" is still his biggest, past 395 million spotify plays.

Promised Land, his debut album, arrived in may 2024 after four years of work. in 2025 he started AFFAIRS, which is a label and a party and a lifestyle line at the same time.

june 2026 he took Affairs to Pacha Ibiza for four tuesdays and picked every lineup himself. Eric Prydz on the first, WhoMadeWho on the second, Franky Rizardo back to back on the third, and a brazilian closer with Mochakk, Volkoder and Doozie. in april he put out "Freaky 1" with Max Styler and Ali Love, two entries down this page.

It's an absolute honor to finally release a track we wrote with Ali Love in Amsterdam three years ago.

beatportal, 10 april 2026

he keeps a home in são paulo, where his mother lives with him, and spends the summer on ibiza. he finished 2025 at eleven on the dj mag hundred.

Max Styler

🚧 bumpy california indie dance + tech house

san luis obispo, california. he opened for Above & Beyond while he was still in high school, which turned into a support slot for Steve Aoki, which turned into a deal. "Badman" with Autoerotique came out on Dim Mak in november 2014 and aoki called it one of his biggest club records of the year.

that version of him made trap and electro. the one you know now started in january 2023 with the "Wanna Dance" ep on John Summit's Experts Only. a fan later turned the title into a bracelet and handed it to him, which he says is still the best thing anyone has given him.

he closed 2025 as beatport's number one top-selling artist in indie dance and number two in tech house, and they made him artist of the month that january.

I almost think that the whole 'one big song' thing is a little bit dated now.

beatportal, 6 january 2026

in october 2025 he started Nu Moda and moved every 2026 release onto it.

Nu Moda basically means 'new style.' It's a reminder to push the boundaries, not do the same thing twice, and look for other people who are naturally in that same mindset.

beatportal, 6 january 2026

april took him to the yuma tent at coachella and put "Freaky 1" out with Vintage Culture and Ali Love. he is on the 2026 guest list for Solomun +1, and he takes lollapalooza chicago on 1 august.

TOBEHONEST

🚧 bumpy los angeles tech house

Luke learned to dj at fraternity parties at the university of arizona, then moved to los angeles for a steady job and lost it to music. asked once what he listens to, he named Max Styler and Solomun, both further up this page.

Groovy, nostalgic, and impactful.

his sound in three words, january 2025

two records got him on the board in 2022, "Daka" on Bump N' Grind and "Maquina De Bailar" on Black Book, both beatport top 100. "Horny" with San Pacho on Insomniac in february 2025 is his most streamed.

but the one he points at himself is "Evil Ways", out on Helix in june 2025 and built on a cleared Willie Bobo sample.

Every time I play it, people sing to me, and it's slowly becoming everybody's favorite song.

dance music nw, 13 may 2026

the run since has been steady rather than loud. "No Lames" with Pedroz and "Too Bright" with WELKER, both on Helix. "Oh My Gosh" and "Pipe Down" on Club Sweat in may. latin melody, hip hop phrasing, tech house underneath.

AYYBO

🚧 bumpy anaheim tech house

Aaron Bonnema, anaheim, california. he came up through high school drumline, released as Bonnema until 2022, and had already been signed to Zeds Dead's Deadbeats back in 2018 under that name.

"HYPNOSIS" with ero808 landed on FUNKSHWAY in july 2022 and changed the shape of things. Pitbull remixed it the following year. he writes his own lyrics and sings on his own records, which almost nobody in this lane does.

I just try not to take myself too seriously, and I feel like people resonate with that.

gray area, 13 june 2023

the bootlegs are half the appeal. Channel Tres, ACRAZE, PinkPantheress, Creeds, all reshaped and handed back out. his own "RIZZ" is past 91 million plays.

It's very mysterious-sounding… it sounds like a good evil.

on his own sound, june 2023

he runs GDB RECORDS and put "Dirty" out on it with Blazey in july. he is at lollapalooza chicago on 1 august, same day as Max Styler.

John Summit

🚧 bumpy chicago tech house

John Schuster, from naperville just outside chicago. he studied accounting at illinois, passed his cpa, and spent his days at Ernst & Young until he walked out in 2019 to make records. the stage name is a ski thing.

I was just like, 'I need a DJ name, I love skiing in the outdoors, I'm gonna name myself Summit.'

dancing astronaut, 16 september 2023

he put "Deep End" out himself in 2020 after a clip took off, then Defected picked it up in june and it went to number one on beatport overall. the year after, he was the top-selling artist on beatport across every genre.

From there I got reached out to from about every major label to sign it, but since Defected has always been the goal for me, I knew that would be a perfect home for the track.

beatportal, 7 july 2020

his label started in may 2022 as Off The Grid and became Experts Only in september 2023 after a dispute over the name. same ski sign the stage name came from. it topped beatport's global label chart in 2024 and most of 2025, and it is where Max Styler's "Wanna Dance" ep and AYYBO's "Obsession" came out, both further up this page.

CTRL ESCAPE, his second album, landed in april 2026. he built Experts Only Festival on randall's island in new york, over fifty thousand people at the first one, and the second runs this september. june through july he held down nine straight mondays at [UNVRS], his first ibiza residency. on 7 and 8 august he is in aspen co-headlining with Dom Dolla, one entry down.

Dom Dolla

🚧 bumpy melbourne house + tech house

Dominic Matheson was born in manila to australian parents, raised in darwin and then melbourne, and cut his teeth in melbourne clubs. "Take It" on Sweat It Out in 2018 is what put him on the map in america. "San Frandisco" the year after won him his first aria.

he has now taken best dance release at the arias four times, and 2023, 2024 and 2025 back to back made him the first artist to win it three years running. in november 2025 they gave him the first ever aria global impact award. he picked up a grammy nomination in 2024 for his remix of Gorillaz, "New Gold."

the collaborator list reads like a dare. MK, Tove Lo, Sonny Fodera, Kid Cudi, Daya, and Nelly Furtado on "Eat Your Man", which went platinum in australia and canada.

last december he put 40,000 people in allianz stadium in sydney and became the first electronic act to headline an australian stadium. this september he does marvel stadium in melbourne, which sold out almost immediately.

Melbourne clubs are where I cut my teeth as a DJ. I don't get to play at home as often as I'd like these days, so after touring all over the world and learning what makes a great show, I wanted this one to be incredibly special.

on the marvel stadium show, 2 june 2026

fridays this summer belong to Hï Ibiza, thirteen of them.

Doing Fridays this year is a huge milestone for me, I can't wait to share it with you guys over summer.

13 january 2026

RÜFÜS DU SOL

🧃 vibes sydney melodic house, played live

three of them, out of sydney since november 2010. Tyrone Lindqvist on vocals and guitar, Jon George on keys and synths, James Hunt on drums, though they swap in the studio. they were just RÜFÜS at home. a trademark problem in america made them RÜFÜS DU SOL there in 2014, and they took the longer name worldwide in 2018.

Atlas went straight to number one in australia in 2013. Bloom in 2016, out on ODESZA's Foreign Family Collective, is the one that travelled. they started Rose Avenue Records in 2018, named after the house near venice beach where they lived and made Solace.

they won the grammy for best dance recording in 2022 with "Alive", and have been nominated five more times, most recently in 2026 for Inhale / Exhale.

Our show is a spectacle. It's a live experience and there's humanity in it. There's human error. From night to night, the performance might be slightly different.

james hunt, los angeles times, 15 august 2025

last august they filled the rose bowl with around sixty thousand people, the first electronic act to play it. in december they were handed a plaque for the highest-selling electronic tour ever recorded. in 2026 they did four nights at madison square garden, and five at the kia forum land across august, every one of them still to come.

When we write music, we aren't necessarily thinking about a vocalist or specific aesthetic. We're searching for a feeling.

tyrone lindqvist, musictech, 5 november 2021

Jamie xx

either lane london house + uk garage

James Smith, london. he met Romy Madley Croft and Oliver Sim at the elliott school in putney, the same school that turned out Burial, Four Tet and Hot Chip, and the three of them have been The xx since 2006. he produces the band and plays the samplers, turntables, drums and keys.

on his own he started with "Far Nearer" in 2011, then In Colour in 2015, which took a mercury nomination, a grammy nomination and number three in the uk. In Waves followed in 2024.

Solomun, further up this page, sent him two unsolicited remixes of "Waited All Night" and both came out in august 2025. he guested at Solomun +1 in ibiza on 12 july.

I had a blast making this remix, the original song is so great it was mega fun to get to play around with it. Thanks Robyn

on remixing robyn, dj mag, 4 december 2025

The xx came back in 2026 after eight years away, three sold-out nights in mexico city, both coachella weekends, rock werchter, and lollapalooza on 2 august. from 26 august he opens all thirty nights of the harry styles residency at madison square garden, which is why he turns up on our tours page more than almost anyone.

I am so lucky to have many wild and beautiful nights playing around the world to wonderful people and this song came about quite naturally, out of all the amazing nights of music and dancing that I get to experience on and off stage.

on "dream night," 21 july 2025

Polo & Pan

🧃 vibes paris french touch

Paul Armand-Delille and Alexandre Grynszpan, both resident djs at Le Baron in paris, met behind the decks there in 2012. the name is the front of Paul and the back of Grynszpan. paul is franco-american and grew up in normandy. alexandre grew up in paris and co-founded radiooooo, a radio station you steer by country and decade.

The duo is the smallest format you can have for a band. A lot of musicians travel alone, and so when there's two of you it makes the experience of travelling the world a lot more durable.

paul armand-delille, clash, 28 march 2025

the Rivolta ep came in 2013, Dorothy in 2014, and Caravelle in may 2017, which went gold in france. Cyclorama followed in 2021 and carried "Ani Kuni", their biggest single, top ten at home.

22:22 arrived in march 2025 with Metronomy, Beth Ditto and PawPaw Rod on it.

Caravelle was a trip around the world, with Latin and African sounds, and Cyclorama was a trip in time, but 22:22 has a more in-the-moment flow to it.

the duo, march 2025

they have more dates on our tours page than anyone else on the roster right now, on an americas run that has them in aspen on 7 and 8 august alongside John Summit and Dom Dolla.

Tinlicker

🧃 vibes utrecht melodic + progressive house

Micha Heyboer and Jordi van Achthoven started in utrecht in 2012. since october 2025 the british vocalist Hero Baldwin is a full third member, so the duo is a trio now and the live show is a band.

"Because You Move Me" with Helsloot came out in 2017 and did very little. then the video went up in february 2021 and the whole thing turned over, past a billion streams. their remix of Robert Miles' "Children" had already gone to number one on beatport in october 2020.

There's only one rule: we have to like it.

four albums now. This Is Not Our Universe on Anjunabeats, In Another Lifetime on Anjunadeep, Cold Enough For Snow with the Metropole Orkest on it, and Dreams Of The Machine in february 2026.

Where is the boundary between human and machine? Can we create a world in which both exist in harmony, organic and digital?

HUGEL

🚧 bumpy marseille latin + afro house

Florent Hugel grew up in marseille on the mediterranean, raised on funk, disco and soul, and started dj-ing on vinyl at sixteen. his remix of "Bella Ciao" went everywhere in 2018 and went platinum in germany, austria and switzerland.

"Morenita" with Cumbiafrica in 2021 is the one that named a lane. latin house was not a thing people said out loud before it.

Latin house wasn't a genre people were talking about, but the moment I started playing those beats, it just clicked.

miami new times, 13 march 2025

it was never a costume either.

I grew up with mixed cultures and spent summers in southern Spain, so flipping Latin music into my style happened naturally.

same interview

then "I Adore You" with Topic and Arash in 2024 went to number one in seven countries. Make The Girls Dance is his label and his party in the same breath, and it is a real a&r operation with other people's records on it, not a private pressing plant.

he took the party to the sahara stage at coachella both weekends this april and used the set to announce Twenty One, his first album, out in june. the title is how long he has been doing this.

Odd Mob

🚧 bumpy brisbane bass + tech house

Harry Hope, out of redland bay on moreton bay, now up the road on the gold coast. it started as a duo with Robbie Jacobs, who left in 2017. "Is It a Banger?" got him to number 70 in the triple j hottest 100 back in 2014.

"LEFT TO RIGHT" is the one that went global, and it began as a joke. he made it as a bootleg on a twitch stream, flipping Soulja Boy's "Crank That." then Dom Dolla, five entries up this page, played it at red rocks.

Next thing you know, Disclosure is in my DMs, Diplo's giving the track a spin, and Dom's sharing requests for it from heaps of the biggest DJs in the world.

tone deaf, 18 august 2022

SOFI TUKKER

🧃 vibes brooklyn house + brazilian pop

Sophie Hawley-Weld and Tucker Halpern met at brown in 2014, at a gallery where she was performing. he had captained the basketball team until illness ended that. they live in the same williamsburg apartment with a third friend and have never been a couple, which people ask about constantly.

she fell for bossa nova as a teenager and learned portuguese so she could sing it properly, which is why half their catalogue is in it. "Drinkee" took its words from "Relógio", a poem by the brazilian writer Chacal, and got them a grammy nomination for best dance recording in 2017. Treehouse took another in 2019.

they started Animal Talk in 2018 as a label and a collective, and relaunched it in 2025 as a management company.

butter in may 2025 was the one they had been promising themselves, recorded in brazil with Seu Jorge, Liniker, Silva and Rael on it.

Tuck and I started the band with a promise that we'd one day return to Brazil in a more meaningful way.

sophie hawley-weld, dj life, may 2025

2026 brought a republic records deal, "COOK" with J Balvin, and "BOBA" on John Summit's Experts Only. the Animal Talk tour runs north america through the autumn, and a dollar a ticket goes to local animal shelters in each city.

Parcels

🧃 vibes byron bay + berlin nu-disco, played live

five of them, out of byron bay in 2014 and in berlin by the end of that year. Jules Crommelin on guitar, Patrick Hetherington and Louie Swain on keys, Noah Hill on bass, Anatole Serret on drums, and all five of them sing.

they met Thomas Bangalter and Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo at a paris show in 2016. what came out of it was "Overnight", which Daft Punk co-wrote and produced, and which turned out to be the last thing the two of them produced for anyone before they split in 2021.

We do have a purpose as a band to our audience: we're giving people joy. I see it as spirit, and it's an incredibly powerful thing.

jules crommelin, pollstar, 8 april 2026

three albums since, the last of them LOVED in september 2025, plus two live records because the live thing is the whole point. they did a tiny desk for npr in october.

the band is split across two hemispheres now, three in berlin and two back in australia, and they move between them with the seasons. they are in aspen on 7 august, on the same bill as John Summit, Dom Dolla and Polo & Pan.

Armand Van Helden

either lane boston + new york house + disco house

born in boston in 1970 to an indo father and a mother of french and lebanese descent. his dad was in the air force, so he grew up across the netherlands, turkey and italy. drum machine at thirteen, dj-ing at fifteen, and out of a day job by 1991.

"Witch Doktor" got into the billboard dance top five in 1994. then in 1997 his remix of Tori Amos, "Professional Widow", went to number one in the uk, and he was reportedly paid around ten thousand dollars for it. two years later "You Don't Know Me" with Duane Harden did it again under his own name.

For most of the '90s, I was a travelling DJ with vinyl in heavy record cases. You didn't move, you often didn't look up at the crowd. You would show up to a gig and the guy before you was in full trance-out mode or playing trip-hop. In the moment you had to improvise and come up with a set

mixmag, 26 july 2017

in 2009 "Bonkers" with Dizzee Rascal took him to number one a third time, and it is still his most-streamed record. that same year he started Duck Sauce with A-Trak, which gave the world "Barbra Streisand" and a grammy nomination.

thirty-something years in and he is still working. Glitterbox at Amnesia on fridays this season, "You" with Mark Knight and D. Ramirez on Toolroom in february, and a set of self-reworks on Southern Fried in may. creamfields on the arc stage at the end of august.

Tiësto

either lane breda trance, then everything

Tijs Verwest, from breda in the south of the netherlands, has been dj-ing since the mid eighties. he co-founded Black Hole Recordings in 1997 and later started Musical Freedom. he took the grammy for best remixed recording in 2015 for his rework of "All Of Me", and has been nominated three times.

Kaleidoscope in 2009 is where he stopped being a trance artist. it is still described as his most experimental record, and it is the reason the two decades after it sound nothing like the two before.

which makes what he is doing now the interesting part. Club Life ended in december 2025 after 978 episodes. two weeks later he launched Prismatic in its place, and it points back where he started.

I got re-inspired by trance music. I wasn't inspired for a long time, but now I've slowly been going through this process of bringing trance back into my sound.

at edc las vegas, may 2026

there is a trance album in progress and two-hour trance sets booked for australia in early 2027. in the meantime he has "Echo Sax Finale" out, mondays at [UNVRS] through august, and creamfields on the steel yard at the end of the month. he has also made "Won't Be Possible" with Odd Mob and Goodboys, further up this page.

Rhye

los angeles downtempo soul

Rhye arrived in 2013 with no faces attached to it and a voice most listeners assumed belonged to a woman. it did not. the project has been led by Mike Milosh since, built around a live band rather than a studio pairing.

Woman came out that year and made the polaris prize longlist. four more records followed, Blood, Spirit, Home, and the JOY ep in june 2026, most of them on Loma Vista and lately on his own Secular Sabbath.

this is not floor music and we are not going to pretend otherwise. it is slow, close, after-hours writing. what earns it a place here is who keeps reaching for it.

Blood Remixed in 2018 is effectively a house record made out of his songs, with Mano Le Tough, Moon Boots, Poolside, Tensnake, Jacques Greene, Channel Tres and Roosevelt all taking a pass. Âme remixed "Black Rain" in 2022 and Jayda G got to it first in 2021. Frank Wiedemann did "Holy."

and it runs the other way too. in 2024 he sang on "3 Days Later" with Adam Ten, one of the eleven on our front page, out on Higher Ground. last october he turned up on Crayon's "Strange People" for Erased Tapes.

the JOY tour reaches mexico city in october and runs the states through to brooklyn in december.

Matija Rodić, from zagreb, in los angeles now. the name is just his name cut in half, MATija RODic.

his first real credit was remixing SNBRN's "California" alongside Chris Lake in 2015, one entry up this page. "Forget It" on Insomniac in 2020 is the commercial one, now past 87 million.

he started Terminal Underground in january 2020 with his own ep and has since put out San Pacho, LUCATI, Martin Ikin, Bleu Clair and TOBEHONEST on it. his fans named the sound matrodasound and it stuck hard enough that spotify uses it.

I just wanted to have a platform where I can present dope music from myself and other up & coming producers with a fresh sound.

on starting the label, september 2022

2026 is mostly AFTER MIDNIGHT, a project with fellow croatian San Pacho that debuted at do lab at coachella and put an ep out in july. deliberately quiet, almost no press, which is the point of it.

My sound changed, or I should say evolved, and will most probably continue to do that going forward.

Tchami

🚧 bumpy paris future house

Martin Bresso was born in the southwest of france and moved to the edge of paris at eight. the name was given to him by an older woman he met on a trip to cameroon.

in 2013 he needed a word for a remix he had made of Janet Jackson and typed "future house" into soundcloud. the word stuck to a whole scene. he has spent the years since gently refusing to own it.

I said 'future house' because I wanted to describe it as a type of house music that hadn't been invented yet.

dj mag, 8 april 2020

"Promesses" with Kaleem Taylor got to number seven in the uk after Ministry of Sound picked it up. he started Confession in 2015, which is where Malaa came from, and where Dombresky's "Utopia" landed in october 2016, further up this page.

in march 2026 he wiped his instagram and announced he was retiring the priest collar and the church imagery that had defined him for a decade. the first record of whatever comes next was "cry for me" with Poo Bear in may.

The next phase starts now… see you out there

6 april 2026

Devault

🚧 bumpy orange county dark, cinematic house

Sage DeVault, out of orange county, california. Depeche Mode and Daft Punk are the two names he keeps returning to, which tells you most of it. dark, cinematic, emotionally loaded dance music.

his remix of DJ Snake and Lauv's "A Different Way" in december 2017 is what opened it up, going to number one on spotify's mint playlist. then came four conceptual tapes, JADE, SAPPHIRE, RUBY and DIAMOND TAPE, each with its own visual half.

2025 is when he tore it up and started again.

The goal this year for me was to completely rewire my brain and approach to dance music and make things that directly fit in a club atmosphere.

beatportal, 14 november 2025

it worked. "Feels Like Us" landed on John Summit's Experts Only that november and became his biggest record. "Zero" with Kučka followed on Insomniac in february, then "SHADES OF BLUE" on Summit's album in april.

After the energy and response to 'Feels Like Us,' I wanted to create something that extends that vibe but is more energetic and vibrant.

on "zero," february 2026

Lewis Delhomme, born in paris in 1997, moved to london at the start of 2025 to make the new record. he sits just outside dance music rather than inside it, and he knows exactly where that leaves him. his own line, in french, is that he is too pop for the electro crowd and too electro for the pop one.

three albums now. Sonic Poems in 2022, co-produced in part by Tim Goldsworthy and mastered by Alex Gopher. Cristal Medium Blue in 2024. 50KWTTS in april 2026, which moves away from the sleek guitar pop into big beat and breaks.

Disclosure

either lane reigate uk garage + house

brothers. Guy Lawrence born 1991, Howard Lawrence born 1994, from reigate in surrey. they made Settle in the loft above their father's auction house.

"Latch" with Sam Smith came out in october 2012 and got to eleven in the uk. it took another two years to reach number seven in america, and it is now past 1.5 billion plays. Settle went straight to number one in 2013 and took a mercury nomination.

ten grammy nominations since, including record of the year for "Talk" in 2020. they have never won one. in february they lost best dance recording for "No Cap" with Anderson .Paak.

Creating something with Andy has been a long time coming. We first met at our show at Forrest Hills in NYC back in 2015 and have been fans of his for even longer.

the duo, dj mag, 7 august 2025

the more interesting story is what they did after leaving the majors. Alchemy in 2023 was the first record made outside that system, and they did not play live at all between 2016 and headlining primavera in 2024. everything since follows from ending that gap.

they did three nights at mission ballroom in denver this april, and creamfields on 28 august is billed as their only uk festival appearance of the year.

Alexander Kotz, born in london in 1992, grew up in beaconsfield. he writes the songs, produces the records and sings on them himself, which is rarer in this lane than it sounds. not a vocalist for hire, not an instrumental producer.

three albums. the first on Parlophone, then he took the next two onto his own Mine Recordings, which he has been running quietly ever since.

it was three of them out of perth from 2013. it is one now. Philip Slabber has run it alone since Leon Debaughn and Liam Merrett-Park left in 2023, and he is still in fremantle.

the closest thing on this page to a hometown act. Thadeus Labuszewski grew up in colorado and took a software engineering degree at cu boulder, which is a sentence you do not often get to write about someone with a billboard number one.

the run went remixes, then Baby Girl in june 2022, then a deal with arista about six weeks later. in june 2023 he launched Good Good Records and put his own single MDMA out as its first release. the label motto, which is also his entire spotify bio, is disco disco good good.

then No Broke Boys. tinashe put the original out in august 2024 and his version came out as its own single on 6 june 2025. on the chart dated 2 august 2025 it went to number one on billboard's hot dance/electronic songs, ending a sixty two week run at the top by someone else, and it reached 36 on the hot 100. first number one on that chart for both of them.

2026 has been busy. the Disco Mafia Pack ep with shoreline mafia landed in february, with TOBEHONEST further up this page on one of the flips, and Push It followed in june.

Tiga

either lane montreal techno + electro

montreal, and the longest career on this page by some distance. Tiga James Sontag founded Turbo Recordings in his home city in 1998 and still runs it. turbo is credited with launching chromeo, azari & III and proxy, and ninja tune's own bio adds duke dumont, gesaffelstein and boys noize to the list.

the record that took him worldwide was Sunglasses at Night, a cover of the corey hart song made with the finnish producer jori hulkkonen as zyntherius. it came out on international deejay gigolo in september 2001 and reached number 25 on the uk singles chart in may 2002. the debut album Sexor followed in 2006 and won the 2007 juno for dance recording of the year. Ciao! came in 2009 and No Fantasy Required on ninja tune in 2016.

then a long gap, and then HOTLIFE on 17 april 2026, out through turbo with secret city records and his first album in over a decade. boys noize, MRD, maara and Fcukers, who are further up this page, all appear on it. beatport made him artist of the month that same month.

he has also remixed the xx, lcd soundsystem, depeche mode, coldcut and moby. he describes the state he is chasing as absolute brain freedom, which is also, in full, his soundcloud bio.

A combination of saying no, making decisions, and playing. Not like a DJ, like a kid.

tiga on absolute brain freedom, beatportal, 6 april 2026

he is at parc jean drapeau in montreal on 8 august, home turf, after hard summer in inglewood and chasing summer in calgary the same weekend.

YOTTO

either lane helsinki melodic house + techno

Otto Yliperttula, born in helsinki and still there. his bandcamp bio, in full, reads: i make music. mostly with a kick drum.

anjunadeep broke him. Memento / Azzurro was his debut for the label in may 2015 and the album Hyperfall followed in september 2018. in 2019 he started Odd One Out and released his own Shifter as its first record. the label is now past its eightieth catalogue number and has become his main home, though the anjunadeep relationship never ended, and Love Shop came out there in may 2025.

the second album Growth arrived in february 2023. then in late 2025 he turned the wheel: the Anti 01 and ANTI 02 eps traded melodic peak time for darker, more hypnotic progressive techno, the sort of thing that works in a room with the lights off. Songs You Might Remember From Some Parties v3 followed in april 2026, and Deep Dive with the vocalist dakota came out on 31 july 2026.

his biggest track is not under this name at all. Something Good is his duo with karolus viitala, and their rework of corona's Rhythm (Of The Night), out on armada in october 2022, has more streams than anything in the yotto catalogue. he has also remixed elderbrook, vintage culture and rufus du sol, all further up this page, plus coldplay and orbital.

I reached a point where I became very comfortable with my own sound and wanted to create a new platform for music that I make, music that I love and music that I feel people should hear.

yotto on starting odd one out, magnetic magazine, 24 july 2019

he plays arc at the lake at castaways in chicago on 7 august, then cross pollination with lane 8 at waterfront park in san diego on 9 august.

a duo, and that is close to the sum of what has been published about them. no names, no home city, no interviews anywhere. what there is instead is a release schedule that has barely paused since october 2025, and a spotify bio describing a blend of tech house and melodic techno built for peak time energy and emotional depth at once.

the run, in order. Afterparty with gaddi on catch & release in october 2025. Swagger with WELKER on higher ground in february 2026. their most played track is Dreams, made with anyma.

Franc Moody

🧃 vibes london funk + disco

a london project built around Ned Franc and Jon Moody, though live it works as a collective that changes size from show to show. their own bandcamp puts it best: contemporary funk, awash with electronic inspiration, human touches, and throbbing grooves.

the reason they belong on a house page is the company they keep. the Dream in Colour remix package, out in september 2020, is a small festival of a record sleeve: gerd janson, folamour, harvey sutherland, skream, EFFY and alex virgo all took a turn. their single most played track is not even one of their own songs, it is their 2017 remix of amber mark's Lose My Cool.

four albums so far. Dance Moves in 2018, Dream in Colour in 2020, Into the Ether in 2022, and Chewing The Fat on night time stories in march 2025, which the label counts as the third studio album. the Treat Yourself ep followed in october 2025 and a deluxe edition in november, padded out with jam recordings named after the rooms they happened in.

The title itself describes the feeling of pure awe and wonder we sometimes get from any number of things, events or moments that are truly mesmerising, hypnotic and magnetic.

franc moody on Super Star Struck, earmilk, 27 july 2017

one thing worth knowing before you buy a ticket. their own 2026 tour page is headed dj sets, so the five north american dates are the two of them behind decks rather than the full band. seattle on 20 august, denver on 21 august, los angeles on 22 august, brooklyn on 23 october and san francisco on 24 october with marc rebillet and chromeo.

JOSHWA

🚧 bumpy london to new york house

came out of the uk underground and now lives in new york, per his own spotify bio. resident advisor calls him one of the most exciting artists to come out of the uk underground dance scene in recent years, and his own description of what he has been making lately is that it has a grime and rap feel to it.

the record was My Humps, made with lee foss and out on repopulate mars in october 2021. a black eyed peas rework, played by FISHER, solardo and Vintage Culture, both of them further up this page, and still his most streamed track by a distance. How We Do with CID followed on the same label in early 2022.

he started NO BAD FRIDAYS in april 2024. since then: the Lost In Music ep on jamie jones's hot creations in july 2025, Out of My Mind on cloonee's hellbent in february 2026, which has been his biggest record since my humps, Work Your Body on catch & release in may, and If Its Real on insomniac in july.

asked about day parties in 2022, he was unambiguous.

It's a great vibe, everyone's out there having a swim and stuff. There are some absolute party animals out there just going crazy.

joshwa to dancing astronaut, 25 august 2022

which is useful context for the denver date, because it is a day party. day trip on the rooftop at club vinyl, sunday 6 september, one in the afternoon until eight, with fallon and george smeddles, put on by insomniac. before that he is at creamfields on saturday 29 august, on the halo stage hosted by trick.

Chris Stussy

🚧 bumpy amsterdam house

Niels Steenbergen grew up in leiden, half an hour from amsterdam, and is based in amsterdam now. dj mag describes what he makes as groove led house music, warm and effortlessly groovy, often deep and dubby, with skippy breakdowns and glimmering pads on top.

he launched Up The Stuss in november 2020 and named it after a hashtag his own crowd had started using on an australian tour. east end dubs, janeret, locklead and malin genie all release on it. All Night Long came out there in may 2023 and changed things. he wrote it in a leeds hotel room in november 2022 in two or three hours, first played it at printworks in london the following march, and it was past five million streams by that october.

the Midtown Playground ep came out on enzo siragusa's FUSE the same year, and in november 2024 he reworked moby's Go, something he originally built as an intro edit for a boiler room in edinburgh.

the debut album, Lost, Found & Forgotten..., landed on 3 april 2026. nineteen tracks in three parts, unreleased material, collaborations and old b sides, with elena moroder, leanne louise, KUČKA, tom did it, jessica care moore and tropics on it. he held a bbc radio 1 residency for the whole of that month and played a set from the first floor of the eiffel tower. he also runs an event series called USS, which opened at the roundhouse in london in february 2025, and he finished 2025 at number 81 in the dj mag top 100.

You just make music because you like it, and if other people resonate with it then that's the most beautiful thing I think there is.

chris stussy to dj mag, 10 october 2023

summer is dense. creamfields on 28 august, reading festival on 30 august, arc in chicago on 4 september and echostage in washington on 5 september. two amnesia nights in ibiza either side of that, and Across Boundaries, his project with locklead, plays fuse on 16 august. he has gone back to back with PAWSA at dc 10, which puts two names from this page on one booth.

Wade

🚧 bumpy seville tech house

from seville, and spanish trade press treats him as the artist carrying spanish tech house furthest abroad. the first record that travelled was the RAVEolution ep on solardo's SOLA in january 2018, with the title track getting its first play from danny howard on bbc radio 1. Get Your Money, made with solardo, followed on the same label in april 2021.

a month after that came Mi Amor with cloonee, out on CLNE on 28 may 2021, and it is still his biggest record by a wide distance.

Criterio started in 2020 as an event brand, with a sold out night at fabrik in madrid, and became a label in november 2021 in partnership with universal music spain. the first release was his own Passion. he told vicious magazine at the time that he had wanted his own label for a long time, to put his own musical judgement in front of people and make criterio the sound he gets recognised for.

Llevaba mucho tiempo con ganas de lanzar mi propio sello, para poder expresar mi propio criterio musical al mundo.

wade, vicious magazine, 18 november 2021

since then criterio has carried Organ Work with rello and Dance To The Rhythm with KENZ in 2025, then Right Move and People Stompin' in 2026. CHAOS ENGINE broke the pattern, landing on UP Music on 20 july 2026.

on 6 june 2026 he headlined loop festival at fabrik in madrid, a twelve hour bill he shared with FISHER and gordo.

Max Dean

🚧 bumpy london house

london, and the hub of a small family operation. his cousin Luke Dean is below on this page and his younger brother joss dj s too, and all three are on the roster of the label max started.

that label is neXup recz, which opened in october 2023 with a various artists compilation called NX-GEN and now carries julian fijma, ALISHA, locky, robbie doherty, tommy phillips, obskür and cam stockman among others. two of those names are elsewhere on this page.

the record that raised him was Reckless (2024), a rework of azari & III made with the group themselves and out on positiva in june 2024. the record that broke him was Can't Decide, made with locky and luke dean, out on nexup through FFRR in may 2025. mall grab and mj cole both remixed it, and in december 2025 it was voted best track of the year at dj mag's best of british awards.

Music-wise, I wouldn't say we are going for a strict sound, just good music that is current and represents and highlights the artists who release with us.

he plays creamfields on friday 28 august on the nexup stage, back to back with luke dean, and again at reading the next day. on halloween he brings nexup to the warehouse project in manchester, which has already sold out.

Rossi.

🚧 bumpy london minimal house

the full stop is part of the name. london, and one of the reasons the minimal end of uk house got loud again. his own words on resident advisor: sets built for lifting a crowd, lots of cuts, hats and percussion, stripped down over jazzy and soulful basslines.

the Dub Inventions ep on lowerhand in october 2018 went to number one on beatport's minimal releases chart inside twenty four hours, with apollonia, jamie jones, rossko and wAFF all playing it. dj mag named him one of its artists to watch for 2020 off the back of that, and one thing he said in that piece was about rich nxt, whose records he had been learning from.

[Rich NXT] has always been a massive inspiration for me, right from when I first started producing on my banged up MacBook. Now that I know Rich personally, it's so special for me to look back at that moment and still pinch myself about it all.

rossi. to dj mag, 9 january 2020

then solid grooves in 2019, eastenderz in 2020, and the Get On The Floor ep on hot creations in july 2023, with dj slugo on one of the tracks. his own label is Homegrown, stylised ROSSI.HOME//GRXWN, and it now runs past its seventeenth catalogue number with jamback, jansons, vitess and dean turnley on it.

the crossover record is High On Me with jazzy, out on 20 june 2025 and now his most played by a very long way. On Your Mind with bbyclose followed on 24 july 2026. in november 2025 he remixed todd terry for hard times, and in february 2026 he headlined a brits week show for war child at the warehouse project alongside fatboy slim and Josh Baker.

the august bank holiday is three festivals in three days. creamfields on friday on the apex stage, sharing it with FISHER and John Summit, then the warehouse stage at reading on saturday and at leeds on sunday.

Sidney Charles

🚧 bumpy lisbon house

born in hamburg, years in berlin, and based in portugal now, where resident advisor says he has room to surf and think. his bio there gives the sound a name people actually use, the sidney sound: heavy low ends, chunky drums, cavernous low frequencies and rhythms aimed at the body rather than the head.

the Ruffline ep on 8bit in august 2013 is where the wider audience arrived, and in november 2019 he started Heavy House Society, opening it with barem's Hollow. the label has since become a touring brand as well as a catalogue, with showcases in ibiza and newcastle this autumn.

I sampled quite a few bits for my tune on HHS. Normally when I get to the studio I always first get through some very old records and see what I could use in some of my tracks.

sidney charles to magnetic magazine, 9 october 2019

the last fifteen months have been the busiest stretch of his career. the Let's Pardey ep with kolter and theo nasa in may 2025, the 2025 warp mix of Trip Advisor (Rhythm, Snare, Bass) with BUGS in august, which is now his most played track, the Take It Back ep in november, then On My Mind in february 2026, his first for Chris Stussy's up the stuss, the Face Your Fear ep on insomniac's factory 93 in march, and the Bass Rider ep in may.

ibiza is where to find him this summer. three pyramid nights at amnesia, on 9 august, 16 august back to back with mar-t, and 6 september. before that he plays the forest stage at creamfields on saturday 29 august with Omar+, and he brings heavy house society to the warehouse project in manchester on 3 october.

Purple Disco Machine

🧃 vibes dresden disco + house

Tino Piontek, born in dresden and still working there, which is not a city that shows up often on a page like this. the name is a joint tribute, prince on one side and gloria estefan's miami sound machine on the other. allmusic files the sound as house, neo disco and dance pop, and his own label copy has settled on deep funk.

Hypnotized with sophie and the giants, out on positiva on 8 april 2020, is the one that went everywhere. it went platinum in italy and reached number ten on the global shazam chart, and it is still his most played track by a long way.

the albums run Soulmatic in 2017 and Exotica in 2021, both for sweat it out, the australian label that also released dom dolla, rüfüs du sol and crooked colours further up this page, then Paradise for columbia in september 2024 with nile rodgers, shenseea, metronomy, jake shears and roosevelt on it. a club companion, Club Paradise, followed that december and a bonus edition in april 2025. the newest thing is the Disco Cherry single, out on 8 may 2026.

the remixes are their own career. he has reworked dua lipa's Don't Start Now, the shapeshifters' Lola's Theme and, in may 2022, lizzo's About Damn Time. that last one won best remixed recording at the 65th grammy awards in february 2023, which per the recording academy's own database is his only nomination and also his only win.

this summer he has the thursday night residency at pacha in ibiza, pure pacha, running from july through to a closing party on 1 october. in denver he plays the day trip block party at the junkyard on 26 september, a one in the afternoon start, on a bill with ZHU and lp giobbi.

Cloonee

The people of LA have welcomed me with nothing but open arms. Being in the melting pot of LA has unlocked parts of my artistic nature that I didn't know I had.

north america in october, dprtmnt in toronto on the ninth and village studios in vancouver on the eleventh, then belfast on 14 november and an eastenderz night at the warehouse project in manchester on 20 november alongside Cloonee.

a chicago duo, Via Rosa on vocals and Na'el Shehade on production, together since 2014 out of the thempeople collective. their own site sums it up in four words: happy sad music handmade in chicago.

ghostly international signed them in 2019 and put out Dance Without Me the following february. the record that travelled furthest is You've Done Enough, made with Gorgon City in january 2021, and they have two more with gorgon city, Nobody on realm in 2020 and Lost & Found in 2023.

na'el shehade to vocalo, 28 january 2026

Lee Burridge

🧃 vibes uk organic house

his first gig was on 26 december 1983, in a bar in eype, dorset, that his parents owned. he has been at it ever since, and his own resident advisor bio still reads, in full: lee has been a dj for more than three decades. he kind of likes it.

the route from there took in hong kong from 1991, where he helped build a club scene from very little, and the full moon parties on ko pha ngan. back in london he started Tyrant with craig richards at fabric in 2000, which is what made his name internationally.

then, in 2011, a rooftop party in williamsburg turned into All Day I Dream, which is now a label, a touring party and a way of describing a whole sound. beatport's own writers credit it with popularising what people call organic house. he has described what he wanted more plainly than that, saying he believed he could make a place where melodic house and techno could live and breathe. a sister label, All Day I Dream In Waves, followed in 2021.

his own records mostly come out on it. the Melt album with lost desert in july 2019, the November Snowflakes ep in november 2025, and Fading Out on 10 july 2026. the exception is the one everybody knows, Lost In A Moment with matthew dekay, which came out on innervisions in june 2012.

I don't build the boat. I don't drive the boat. I just give the boat a little push.

lee burridge on the artists he signs, beatportal

the autumn is all party dates. new york on 19 september, open to close on his own. los angeles on 3 october, montreal on 12 october, then bali on 15 november before an australian run, byron bay on the twentieth, sydney on the twenty eighth and melbourne on the twenty ninth.

Pete Tong

either lane london to los angeles house

if you have ever found a record because a radio show played it, some of the machinery for that is his. he has been on bbc radio 1 for decades and is still there, a friday night dance show that ran unbroken through july 2026.

the other half of the job was a and r. he compiled The House Sound Of Chicago in 1986, licensed from dj international, which is how a lot of britain first heard chicago house. the same year he founded FFRR at london records. orbital started there. goldie's Timeless came out through it, and so did dj shadow's Endtroducing.

he was made an MBE in the 2014 new year honours. the citation in the london gazette reads, in full, for services to broadcasting and music.

since 2015 he has also run the orchestral side, ibiza classics with jules buckley conducting, which started as a radio 1 ibiza prom and has grown into arena tours. in may 2025 he started a label, Places & Spaces, which he described as a personal project reflecting the sounds closest to his heart.

Really looking forward to bringing some Ibiza vibes to All Points East this Sunday. It's a great chance to play these tracks in the heart of London and bring a selection of some of my favourite tunes to a festival crowd.

pete tong to dj mag, 14 august 2025

his 7 august date at haydock park is an ibiza classics show with the orchestra rather than a dj set, part of a summer run through castles and country houses. creamfields on saturday 29 august is the dj. the winter arena tour lands in december, finishing with two nights at the o2.

born and raised in croatia, which is not where you would expect latin flavoured tech house to come from, and that mix is exactly what he is known for. his own spotify description of the music, in full, is bleep bloop unts unts music.

La Pasion with Matroda in 2021 was the first one that turned into a festival record, and Amor followed in april 2022 on matroda's terminal underground. that is still his most played track.

After 'La Pasion' ended up being a club and festival smash I wanted to make a follow-up that was similar, yet again ear and eye catching. I sent the 'Amor' demo to Matroda and when he premiered it at EDC Las Vegas I knew it was a special one.

since then: Trompeta in july 2022, the As Long As We Got House ep that november, and the No Guest List ep with a deluxe edition in august 2024 carrying remixes from jaded, greg 99 and bruno furlan.

2026 has mostly been AFTER MIDNIGHT, the project he and matroda started together. it is deliberately not billed as a duo. the press copy calls it a self contained creative world with a limited run of releases and appearances, which in practice has meant Rich & Handsome in march, a live debut at the do lab stage at coachella, and the AF:MN ep on 23 july 2026. his own 2026 singles, Alcoholic and Bootay, have come out on libera.

he is at chasing summer in calgary on 2 august, and escape psycho circus at the end of october.

Vandelux

Evan White, born in vancouver and living in the bay area. the name is built from the cities he has lived in, vancouver, deland and luxembourg. asked to name his own genre he said he was still trying to figure that out, then landed on chill electronic with the caveat that plenty of it does not fit.

he came to this late and from somewhere unusual. sixteen years in finance, last job chief operating officer at a hedge fund, and he only went full time in music around 2024.

RL Grime

straight up, he is not a house artist and nobody says he is. Henry Steinway makes trap and bass music and has done since 2012, when a remix of kanye west's Mercy made with salva went everywhere. VOID arrived on wedidit in november 2014 and NOVA in 2018.

what earns him a place here is the last third of PLAY, his 2023 album on his own Sable Valley. the record is built in three sections, and the closing one, RUSH, is house, breaks, garage and techno.

This section of the album became a place where I could venture back into the house/breaks/garage/techno/etc. roots that got me into dance music in the first place. I think I was always hesitant to release anything like this as RL because I wanted a clear distinction from my older projects.

Carla Frayman, from istanbul, turkish and italian, classically trained and a multi instrumentalist before any of the dj part. her label describes what she makes as lush, hypnotic productions that balance depth, toughness and a cool sort of beauty. beatport's own writers put it more usefully: her records bounce from organic house to deep house to electro pop.

Adriatique

🧃 vibes zurich melodic techno

two swiss producers, both called adrian. Adrian Shala and Adrian Schweizer met in zurich in 2008 and have worked as adriatique since 2009, out of the same city ever since. their own site calls what they do hypnotic techno storytelling.

diynamic picked them up in 2013 and afterlife released the debut album Nude in september 2018, which is still the record the rest is measured against. their most played track is not theirs though. it is their remix of RÜFÜS DU SOL's In the Moment, and it sits at nearly eighty million plays.

they run two labels. Siamese since 2016, which put out its eighth anthology in july 2025, and X Recordings, which has been the home for everything recent and which moved into partnership with warner music in july 2026 for Coming Home.

X is also a show. it started in december 2022 as an audiovisual production and now runs under the name X.FOREVER, with the tagline the future is yet to come. in april 2025 they played the royal albert hall in london, open to close, the first electronic act to do that there.

Performing at the Royal Albert Hall is a dream come true. This venue holds a special place in music history, and we're honored to bring electronic music to its storied stage.

they met at an after hours club in montreal in 2002 and have been a duo ever since. for the first decade they made big room records under the name sultan and ned shepard, and somewhere around 2015 the billing shortened to sultan + shepard.

the real turn came in early 2020, when they signed to lane 8's This Never Happened and went back toward melodic house and progressive. everything since has come out there: Something, Everything in 2021, Forever, Now in 2023, Endless, Dawn in 2024, and Circle In Time: The Trilogy that november, which they tied together as three chapters of one story and then toured as a live show through early 2025.

Sometimes balancing emotion and dancefloor appeal on a record is tricky, but in this case we were really happy with the result.

as sultan + ned shepard, your edm, 19 august 2014

Michael Gray

🧃 vibes london disco + soulful house

london, and one of the longest unbroken runs on this page. since 1994 he has been half of Full Intention with jon pearn, a duo that ran the dtension label from 1999 and started full intention records in 2009, and which is still going.

under his own name the record is The Weekend, out in 2004 with shena singing. it reached number seven on the uk singles chart, spent nineteen weeks there, and went to number one on the official dance chart for three weeks. more than two decades later it has over two hundred million plays.

he started Sultra Records in 2018 and has released almost everything through it since, including the album Optimism in 2024 and You & Me on 29 may 2026, his third. that one has mike dunn, kelli sae, tania foster, phebe edwards and audrey martells across thirteen tracks. Character in a voice is really important for me, but most importantly I want someone who is easy to work with.

Juos

los angeles, and his own description of the music is tech house and latin tech house, with traditional latin elements worked into it. the catalogue backs that up: Dile, Candela, Sazón, Dame Más (Gasolina).

Dile is the one. it came out in march 2024 as his cut on Welcome to Hell III, the compilation series on Cloonee's hellbent records, and it is still his most played by a distance. dancing astronaut listed him among the newcomers on that record at the time.

a year later he was on dirtybird with WTF, and since then thrive music has become his regular home, with Side Man, Candela, Body 2 Body and Come My Way across ten months. he has also made two records with wax motif, and Give It To Me came out on Westend's trace amounts in july 2025.

there is almost nothing written about him anywhere, which for an artist at this size is unusual. no interviews, no real name published, no resident advisor page. the records and the bookings are the whole story so far, and both are moving fast.

LP Giobbi

🧃 vibes eugene, oregon piano house

Leah Chisholm, from eugene, oregon, and a jazz trained pianist before anything else. ninja tune's own description of her puts the piano first: someone who takes inspiration from jazz and prefers spontaneous, live collaboration to pre programmed structures.

two albums on counter records, Light Places in may 2023 and Dotr in october 2024, the second of them named after the way she used to sign notes to her parents before she could spell daughter. dj mag made her best producer of 2023 off the back of the first one. her single most played track is her remix of taylor swift's Cruel Summer.

the bigger thing she has built is FEMME HOUSE, a registered non profit she co founded in 2019 with lauren spalding, who records as hermixalot. it started with about a dozen people round laptops at ableton's los angeles studio. it now runs free and pay what you can workshops, two fellowships and an awards ceremony, and says it has taught fifteen thousand creators across seventy seven countries and put more than a million dollars back into free programming.

We've seen Moog help in the same way. We've just seen big gatekeepers [such as] Spotify open doors.

an italian trio out of milan, Mattia Vitale, Luca De Gregorio and Simone Giani. their own description of the sound has been the same for years: found in the deepest regions of house music, melodic yet energetic, tailor made for the underground but accessible to all.

Wuki

🚧 bumpy denver to los angeles breaks + house

Kris Barman spent five years in a band called innerpartysystem, started wuki in 2011 and moved to denver, where he had a late night radio show. resident advisor and beatport still list him as denver based. his own soundcloud says los angeles now.

his own press description of the sound is booty, breaks, electro and house, with detroit ghettotech and chicago footwork behind it. in november 2019 his remix of miley cyrus's Mother's Daughter was nominated for best remixed recording at the grammys. he did not win, and he was straightforward about what it meant anyway, saying it felt surreal to finally get some recognition after a long time at it.

his first record on this page's terms is older than that: he remixed Kingpin for RL Grime's VOID remix album back in 2015.

The only way for me to do that was to bring it out in my personality. I'm always joking around and I love bouncy, fun music.

wuki to edm.com, 13 march 2021

Sunshine (My Girl), out on thrive in september 2023, is his biggest by a distance, and SOFI TUKKER remixed it. since then: BIGGY BAP with skrillex in march 2025, Ain't It Fun in may, and Whip It with devo themselves in november. he also runs a mixtape series called beats i can't release, for the edits and bootlegs that cannot clear, which is up to a second volume.

he plays breakaway michigan on friday 14 august, global dance festival in denver on 11 and 12 september, and headlines the bellwether in los angeles on 6 november for a night billed as beats i can't release mixtape no. 3.

Peggy Gou

🧃 vibes berlin house

born Kim Min-ji in incheon, south korea, in london from the age of fifteen studying fashion, and in berlin since. resident advisor places the sound somewhere between detroit, london and berlin. her own version, given to mixmag in 2018, was simpler: she wanted the peggy sound to be housey and acid.

the record that made her name underground was It Makes You Forget (Itgehane), from the Once ep on ninja tune in march 2018, the first time she sang in korean on a release. it took independent track of the year at the aim awards that september. dazed had already noted, in may of that year, that she was the first korean woman to play panorama bar.

then a second, much larger breakthrough. (It Goes Like) Nanana came out on xl in june 2023 and reached number five on the uk singles chart, twenty three weeks on it, her first uk top ten. the debut album I Hear You followed on 7 june 2024 with lenny kravitz and villano antillano on it.

I think it is more important for me to keep doing what I believe, instead of just focusing on making a hit.

peggy gou to the harvard crimson, 1 october 2024

she started Gudu Records in berlin in 2019 with the Moment ep and has since put out maurice fulton, dmx krew, special request, mumdance and mogwaa on it, plus an annual Gudu & Friends compilation. her fashion line KIRIN launched the same year under new guards group. she also curates her own party, gou talk, which sold out drumsheds in london in october 2025, and she finished 2025 at number twelve in the dj mag top 100.

her london date on 2 august is her own night, peggy gou on the thames, at the old royal naval college in greenwich, with Prospa also on it. that whole series is worth knowing about, because Dom Dolla played it on the first, Adriatique bring X on the eighth and Michael Bibi closes it on the sixteenth.

Green Velvet

🚧 bumpy chicago chicago house + techno

Curtis Alan Jones studied chemical engineering at the university of illinois, left graduate school in 1991 and went back to chicago to make records instead. he has used two names ever since. Cajmere, from 1991, for traditional chicago house, vocal led and soulful. Green Velvet, from the middle of that decade, for the darker, acid and techno leaning side with the deadpan spoken vocals.

he put it plainly to the quietus in 2012: house is more about the vocals and songs, techno is more instrumental and a bit darker, and house is really about dancing.

as cajmere the breakthrough was Coffee Pot (It's Time for the Percolator) in 1992, and Brighter Days with dajae was the hit that paid for the label. he founded Cajual Records in 1992 and Relief Records in 1993 as the experimental outlet, and beatport's artist page still lists him as relief's owner.

as green velvet the two that lasted are Flash, out on relief in 1995 and placed at number sixty one on rolling stone's two hundred greatest dance songs, and La La Land, from november 2001, which is now a party series with its own name on festival bills. beyoncé's Cozy on renaissance samples a record he wrote.

I feel it's my duty to continue to make creative and innovative tracks as well as musical events. I love shining the light on new upcoming and emerging artists as well as giving the originators their proper dues.

curtis jones to the recording academy, 17 april 2024

which is more or less what the last two years look like. Butterflies with jamie jones on helix in february 2025, When It Kicks with Layton Giordani on madminds that september, a new La La Land built with MEDUZA on broke in may 2026, and Bounce UR Body with detlef on Cloonee's hellbent in june. four of those names are elsewhere on this page.

he plays arc in chicago on 4 september, back to back with Josh Baker, nocturnal wonderland at glen helen on 19 september, and suwannee hulaween in october with a la la land takeover of his own.

Mochakk

🚧 bumpy sorocaba, brazil house

Pedro Maia, from sorocaba in são paulo state, came up through skating and hip hop, worked as a beatmaker and ended up in house. ninja tune describe what he makes as a blend of brazilian musicality and uk nodding sounds, which is about right.

the moment was filmed. on 4 may 2023 he played a cercle set at the plaza de españa in seville, wrote a track called NO8DO specifically for it, and the video has been watched around four million times. he played a hundred and sixty shows across twenty nine countries that year and took a residency at dc 10 in ibiza.

It's like this little play around, two different time signatures, traveling across the world, missing home. It's all of that duality.

mochakk on NO8DO, edm.com, 15 may 2023

his biggest record is older and simpler, Da Fonk with joni, out on nervous in july 2022. Jealous and The Line followed on circoloco records, and his remix of the martinez brothers and gordo's Rizzla has become one of his most played tracks in its own right.

ninja tune signed him for the From The Stars ep in february 2025, built around a rework of the rah band, with Maria on it, a track he first played at that cercle set. in may 2026 verve gave him nina simone's See-Line Woman to rebuild.

he also opened a club. OBLIQO, a nightclub and cultural space in his home town, launched on 6 september 2024, and he runs his own festival in malta called mochakk calling. he has gone back to back with Disclosure at cercle and with Vintage Culture, both further up this page.

two headline dates on the radar. under the k bridge in brooklyn on 29 august, with dj minx and dj holographic supporting, and gallagher square at petco park in san diego on 24 september, a ten o'clock start two nights before he plays crssd.

Black Coffee

🧃 vibes durban, south africa afropolitan house

Nkosinathi Maphumulo, from durban. the term everybody now uses for what he makes, including unvrs and the o2's own press office, is afropolitan house: traditional african percussion carried into deep house and metropolitan techno, with soulful vocals over the top.

the door opened in 2003, when he was picked as one of two south africans for that year's red bull music academy. his self titled debut followed in 2005 on his own Soulistic Music and took best urban dance album at the south african music awards. he made it without the use of his left arm, which he lost in an accident in 1990, working with a mouse.

the awards that followed are worth stating precisely. one grammy, from one nomination, for best dance/electronic album with Subconsciously at the 2022 ceremony. that is the whole of his entry in the recording academy's database. before that, best international act africa at the bet awards in 2016, reported at the time as the first bet award won by a south african. he finished 2025 at number seventeen in the dj mag top 100, up seven places.

I listen to the voice, I listen to the music, and I follow.

black coffee to billboard africa, 21 november 2025

his most played record is The Rapture Pt.III, made with &ME for keinemusik in june 2023. before that, Drive with david guetta in 2018. he also executive produced drake's Honestly, Nevermind in 2022, and remixed whomadewho's Silence & Secrets. the newest thing is Trippy Yeah with jimi jules on innervisions.

saturdays at hï ibiza have been his since the club opened in 2017, and 2026 is the eighth season, running to 3 october. on 22 may 2026 he sold out the o2 arena in london with a twelve piece orchestra and alicia keys as a surprise guest, which the citizen reported as the first time a south african artist had sold out that room for a music concert. he was, in his own words afterwards, speechless.

on 21 october he opens amsterdam dance event's thirtieth anniversary with a three hour solo set at the ziggo dome, a room he sold out during the same festival a year earlier.

Barry Can't Swim

🧃 vibes edinburgh to london house + broken beat

Joshua Mainnie, from edinburgh, based in london, and a trained pianist first. he is direct about how he sees himself.

It kind of annoys me when people call me a DJ.

barry can't swim to rolling stone uk, 27 march 2024

which is fair, because the live show is a six piece band. drums, keys, and a string section of three violins and a cello. at all points east in august 2025 he headlined for ninety minutes with brass, percussion and guest vocalists on top of that. he does play dj sets too, and promoters bill the two separately.

the record that changed things is When Will We Land?, out on ninja tune on 20 october 2023. number twelve on the uk album chart, number one on the scottish, dance and independent charts, and shortlisted for the mercury prize in 2024. english teacher won. he placed third in the bbc's sound of 2025 poll and was nominated for breakthrough artist at the brits in february 2026, where lola young won.

Loner, the second album, came out on 11 july 2025. in march 2026 he curated a Late Night Tales, opening that series' twenty fifth anniversary, and he has his own label, Earths Only Paradise, which launched with a record by o'flynn and took over the whole warehouse project in manchester for a night in november 2025.

in may 2026 he signed to atlantic records uk. Return To Bhibo came first, then Dance Dance Dance! on 24 july, which nme called full french touch. he has also remixed Disclosure, further up this page, plus ben böhmer and diplo.

the australian run in october is three festivals in three days for the same promoter, and he tops all three: overtone on the gold coast on the second, freeform in melbourne on the third, mode in sydney on the fourth.

CamelPhat

🧃 vibes liverpool melodic house

Dave Whelan and Mike Di Scala, from liverpool, together since the mid two thousands. they describe themselves as blending deep, melodic and progressive house, and they are honest about where they started: they made tech house at the beginning, mike told mixmag, because they could not get a gig otherwise.

then Cola. made with Elderbrook, further up this page, in a session whelan says took two or three hours, and released by defected on 23 june 2017. number one on beatport and traxsource inside a week, the most shazamed record in ibiza that summer, twenty weeks on the uk chart and triple platinum there. it was nominated for best dance recording at the sixtieth grammys, which per the recording academy's database is their only nomination and they did not win it.

We live and breathe dance music. We're not interested in the money or fame.

camelphat to complex, 9 july 2024

the run since: Breathe with cristoph and jem cooke on pryda presents in 2018, Critical with Green Velvet in january 2021, the Dark Matter album on sony that october with noel gallagher and jake bugg on it, and The Sign with Anyma on afterlife in 2022.

When Stars Align is theirs. announced in 2021, first record out in october 2022, and now the home for almost everything they release, including the Spiritual Milk album in september 2023. josh gigante, volkoder and hollt are on the roster. in august 2025 ARTBAT, just below, remixed cola for its own anniversary.

2026 is nineteen nights at hï ibiza in the theatre, a residency they call summer of love, ten fridays in may and september and nine sundays across july and august, closing on 2 october. at creamfields they play the steel yard on saturday 29 august, inside amelie lens's aura block.

ARTBAT

🚧 bumpy kyiv melodic house + techno

a ukrainian duo from kyiv, working together since 2014, who go by Artur and Batish everywhere they control the copy. beatport files them under melodic house and techno and has had them as the top selling artist in that category.

richie hawtin played their 2015 track Mandrake for the best part of a year, which is how the first doors opened. the record that opened the rest was a remix: monolink's Return to Oz, reworked in 2018, still their most played track by a distance at over a hundred million.

from there, two eps on diynamic with dino lenny, one of them called Upperground, Montserrat / Closer with whomadewho on watergate in 2019, and Best of Me with sailor & i, which went to number one on beatport in 2020.

Of course, rhythm is the dance mover. So good rhythm is most important for the dance track. We dance with the rhythm.

artbat to the recording academy, 9 may 2020

they launched UPPERGROUND in august 2021, taking the name from that diynamic ep, and it is now a label and a touring show at once. in 2025 they filled legia warsaw stadium with twenty two thousand people under that banner, with armin van buuren, korolova and miss monique guesting. armin is also on Take Off, made with them for armada in february 2024.

they remixed Cola for CamelPhat and Elderbrook in august 2025, which is the record just above this one, and when dj mag asked them for their favourite track of 2025 they picked Adriatique's remix of RÜFÜS DU SOL's In The Moment. both of those are on this page too. they entered the dj mag top 100 proper for the first time in 2025 at number seventy three.

the rest of 2026: resistance at amnesia in ibiza on 19 august, brunch electronik in barcelona on the twenty third, amsterdam dance event in october, and dreamstate socal in long beach on 20 and 21 november, which is a trance festival and very much on purpose.

Adam Port

🧃 vibes berlin house + techno

Adam Polaszek, born in berlin, and one of the four who started Keinemusik there in 2009 alongside Rampa, &ME and reznik, with the illustrator monja gentschow shaping how all of it looks. their own line for what the label does, unchanged for years, is refining house and techno off the beaten path.

he did not come from techno. his resident advisor biography has him starting at sixteen in hardcore punk, new york, boston and washington dc hardcore specifically, then moving through hip hop and turntablism before any of this. dub, dancehall, soul and psychedelic rock are all in there.

he is also the one with the crossover record. Move, made with stryv, orso and malachiii and out on keinemusik in june 2024, went top ten in six countries, went gold or platinum in belgium, france, italy, spain and greece, and picked up a camila cabello version that october. it is the collective's biggest song by a distance.

his own artist bio is short enough to quote in full and worth reading.

I really hate it to write/read my own biography.

adam port, his own spotify artist bio

since then: The Dream on defected in july 2025, a remix of sven väth's Ritual Of Life for cocoon, and Be The One with sg lewis on keinemusik in april 2026.

the three keinemusik dates in the united states in 2026 are all his. pappy & harriet's in pioneertown on 10 october, the concourse project in austin on the sixteenth, and iii points in miami on the seventeenth.
