Rampa

🚧 bumpy berlin house + techno

Gregor Sütterlin, berlin, the second of the keinemusik founders on this page. drums from primary school, djing from twelve, and a training as an electrical engineer that he has actually used: he runs TEILE, a company that builds and sells analogue effects units designed specifically for djs. his own resident advisor blurb is four words. i do keinemusik and teile.

I think people started liking us because we really did our own thing, not trying to be anybody else

rampa to forbes, 18 august 2023

he is the one who plays deliberately less. his bio describes a less is more approach and choosing bookings more carefully. he is also the remixer of the three. Adriatique's Nude in 2019 on afterlife, further up this page, plus moderat, ry x, justice and tame impala.

his biggest record is a collaboration. Abu Simbel, made with WhoMadeWho for cercle records in march 2021, which is the most played track either act has. they followed it with Everyday in august 2022. his own Terrace came out on keinemusik in 2019 and Les Gout with chuala in 2022. he also runs a second label, VOD.

in 2022 he and &ME co produced two tracks on drake's Honestly, Nevermind, an album Black Coffee executive produced. on 30 december 2024 he played the sphere in las vegas as part of Anyma's residency there.

this summer he is at circoloco at dc 10 in ibiza on 17 august with &ME, the warehouse project in manchester on 19 september, and pacha in ibiza on 6 october alongside sven väth.

&ME

🧃 vibes berlin house

the third keinemusik founder on this page, and the one who leans furthest toward the song. his own bio describes the aim as linking innovative production with reception people actually want, and his catalogue bears that out: where Adam Port has the crossover hit and Rampa has the hardware company, &ME has the vocals.

the two records that carry his name furthest are both called the rapture. The Rapture Pt.II came out on keinemusik in november 2018. The Rapture Pt.III, made with Black Coffee and released in june 2023, is black coffee's most played track anywhere and one of the collective's biggest. earlier there was After Dark in 2014 and Garden in 2019.

he and rampa co produced two tracks on drake's Honestly, Nevermind in 2022. the stage name itself, per his bio, is meant as a small act of modesty.

the collective's own line for what all three of them are doing has not changed in fifteen years: refining house and techno off the beaten path. in april 2024 they took that to the pyramids at giza for a night, which is not a sentence you get to write about many labels.

his summer is european. çeşme on 4 august, twiga on the ninth, north coast in egypt on the fourteenth billed against rampa, circoloco at dc 10 on the seventeenth with him, then amstelveen, madrid, brussels, manchester and são paulo through to october.

WhoMadeWho

🧃 vibes copenhagen electronic pop + house

Tomas Høffding, Tomas Barfod and Jeppe Kjellberg, from copenhagen, working together since about 2003. their own soundcloud bio is three words: shapeshifting disco chameleons. resident advisor calls them one of the definitive underground bands of their generation.

they started as a band and the first album came out on gomma in 2005. what pulled them into this world was a run of collaborations that reads like a guest list for this page. Montserrat / Closer with ARTBAT on watergate in may 2019. Abu Simbel with Rampa on cercle records in march 2021, still their most played record. Miracle with Adriatique in september 2023, which RÜFÜS DU SOL then remixed. Black Coffee reworked their Silence & Secrets in 2022, and in september 2025 they made Mind Off with Carlita and orsay for ninja tune.

The past few years have been incredibly intense for WhoMadeWho, filled with live world tours, Hybrid DJ shows across the globe, and the establishment of our own festival and record label, The Moment.

whomadewho to electronic groove, 13 september 2024

that festival and label is The Moment, and their eighth album Kiss & Forget came out on it in september 2024 with ry x, blue hawaii, kölsch and adriatique across it.

worth knowing before you buy a ticket: they run two different shows. the full band, and a hybrid dj set where barfod is in the booth and one of the other two sings and plays keys and effects over the top of it. they took best live performer at the beatport awards in 2024 and a dj award in the organic house category the same year.

the united states run is the first week of september. marquee skydeck in new york on the third, the surf lodge in montauk on the fourth, the concourse project in austin on the fifth, and arc in chicago over labor day weekend. their newest record is ENERGY, made with gordo and out on 17 july 2026.

Monolink

🧃 vibes berlin songwriting + melodic house

Steffen Linck, berlin, on his own. his bio calls him a singer songwriter and electronic music producer who connects the narrative structure of a song to the forward push of electronic rhythms, which sounds like label copy until you see the show.

the show is one man surrounded by gear. two synthesizers facing opposite directions, drum machines, pads, a microphone, an electric guitar, and everything played live. electronic groove reviewed a night at brixton academy in november 2025 and called it an actual concert rather than a rave, which is the right distinction.

The way my live set is structured is that I have a lot of freedom to improvise and change things on the fly.

monolink to magnetic magazine, 1 october 2025

the debut album Amniotic came out on embassy one in april 2018 and had Return to Oz on it. a year later ARTBAT, further up this page, remixed that track, and their version is now the most played thing with his name on it by a factor of two. ben böhmer's remix of his Father Ocean is not far behind.

Under Darkening Skies followed in june 2021 and The Beauty Of It All, his third, on 26 september 2025. Your River with sam shure came out on cercle records that june. his first record of all, The End, was made with acid pauli back in 2015.

the north american run for the album was february and march 2026, toronto, montreal, brooklyn, chicago, vancouver and seattle, with staging built by vita motus and do lab. the rest of 2026 is european, including cercle festival in paris and superbloom in munich on 4 september.

born in kalamazoo, raised in suburban detroit, and playing panorama bar in berlin by eighteen. where he lives now depends which of his own pages you read, but ibiza is on all of them.

Patrick Topping

🚧 bumpy newcastle tech house

newcastle, and still there. the Boxed Off ep landed on hot creations in april 2014 and the opening track, Forget, was named track of the season in ibiza that summer. that is the pivot.

six months later he made Voicemail with Green Velvet for relief, then the Now ep with him in 2015, then Mad Motion in 2024, a full decade after the first one. layton giordani remixed voicemail in 2023 and the two of them made Tonight together in june 2026, which is a nice way for a record to keep going.

I used to play very linearly, sticking to the same BPM, and now it's more just like a rollercoaster going up and down.

patrick topping to dj mag, 10 january 2023

Trick is his, a label and an event series both, started in 2019. ewan mcvicar, ben hemsley, hannah laing, anfisa letyago and dj deeon have all released on it. his own 2025 went out through it and 2026 has been the opposite, records on Cloonee's hellbent in march, metamorfosi in april and madminds in june. he also remixed Armand Van Helden's Keep Forgettin' in 2025.

he has played sober since 2017 and has said it changed his relationship with music and with partying, which is not a thing many djs at his level say out loud. he now runs an alcohol free daytime rave in october because of it.

dj mag made him dj of the year at its best of british awards in december 2022. this summer he plays creamfields on 29 august, and trick lands in ibiza at 528 on 2 october.

Marco Carola

🚧 bumpy naples techno + tech house

born in naples on 7 february 1975 and still italian based. resident advisor's line for him is four words long and hard to improve on: a global ambassador of techno.

he was making records with adam beyer on drumcode by 1998, mixed Fabric 31 in 2006, and put out Play It Loud! in 2011, which is still the record with his name on it that most people know. the sets have travelled a long way from the hard naples techno he started with toward something groovier, and ibiza spotlight's read is that the groove is the part that never changed.

the thing that made him permanent is Music On. he started it in 2011 at the shelbourne hotel in miami, brought it to amnesia in ibiza the following year, and it has been at pacha since 2019. his own description of it is a brand proposing the creation of a cutting edge club sound.

the 2026 season runs fridays from 15 may to a two night close on 8 and 9 october, and the lineup is close to a directory of this page. Adriatique, ANOTR, Black Coffee, Chris Stussy, Cloonee, Jamie Jones, Jazzy, Mau P, Max Dean, Michael Bibi, PAWSA, Rampa, Rossi., Seth Troxler, Vintage Culture and Wade are all on it.

he has also founded a run of labels going back to the nineties, design, zenit, question, one thousands and do.mi.no among them. in august 2023 he played back to back with Solomun for pacha's fiftieth anniversary. his newest record is an edit of nic fanciulli's Lalo's Groove, out on saved in october 2025.

SG Lewis

🧃 vibes london house + disco

he started as a resident dj at chibuku in liverpool, which is where, in his own telling, he fell for club culture. london since. resident advisor describes what he does as blending house, disco, funk and soulful pop into high energy club sets.

the other half of the job is writing for other people. he produced dave's 100M's and co wrote Hallucinate for dua lipa's future nostalgia.

I had to learn what my voice is and how I could use my voice, because I had always approached things from the standpoint of production before.

sg lewis to dancing astronaut, 2 november 2020

four records under his own name so far. times in february 2021, AudioLust & HigherLove in january 2023, the HEAT ep with tove lo in june 2024, and Anemoia on 5 september 2025 with london grammar, shygirl and oliver sim across it.

his club label is Forever Days, which carries chloe caillet, dj seinfeld and loods and runs parties in london, new york, ibiza and tulum. in april 2026 he made Be The One with Adam Port for keinemusik, and he is on Carlita's album with a track called the moment. all three of those names are on this page.

the american dates are worth knowing: knockdown center in new york on 21 august, portola in san francisco and ocean way in santa monica both on 26 september, and seismic dance event in austin on 13 november. before that, ants at ushuaïa on 8 august and a Black Coffee night at hï on 12 september.

Bob Moses

🧃 vibes vancouver house + songwriting

Tom Howie and Jimmy Vallance went to the same high school in vancouver and bonded over pop punk, then found each other again in brooklyn and started making records together in 2012. resident advisor calls the result decidedly post club, which is a useful way of saying songs that work in a room.

Tearing Me Up, from the 2015 album Days Gone By on domino, was nominated for best dance recording at the 2017 grammys. worth being precise about this one, because a lot of bios are not: the recording academy's database shows one nomination and no wins for them. the grammy that year went to rac for remixing the track, and that award belongs to the remixer.

Silence is our canvas. There's nothing and then all of a sudden you create music and put a statement into the world that never existed before.

jimmy vallance to atwood magazine, 9 june 2023

their biggest record is a collaboration. Inner Light, made with Elderbrook in july 2021, which Barry Can't Swim then remixed. jamie jones's remix of their Enough to Believe is close behind, and they made Desire with ZHU. four names on this page in one paragraph.

BLINK, their newest album, came out on 17 october 2025 with a deluxe edition following on 10 july 2026. they play both formats, the band and a straight club set, and the 2026 dates are billed as the latter.

osheaga in montreal on 31 july, then nitsa in barcelona on 21 august, ibiza on the twenty third, amsterdam on 30 october and factory town in miami on 14 november.

Poolside

🧃 vibes los angeles daytime disco

Jeffrey Paradise started this in a converted backyard pool house in los angeles in early 2011, originally with filip nikolic, and has run it alone for years now. the genre is his own invention and he trademarked it: daytime disco, described on his own pages as light but danceable, sunny, liquid.

the record everybody knows is a neil young cover. Harvest Moon, from the debut album Pacific Standard Time in july 2012, has more plays than the rest of the catalogue put together.

five albums so far, the most recent being Blame It All On Love on counter records in october 2023. since then it has been singles, including Pull Together with Satin Jackets in march 2025 and Bedroom Eyes with stevie appleton in june 2026. he made I Feel High with DRAMA, and Vandelux remixed harvest moon, both of them further up this page.

I didn't choose an instrumental. I chose a song. It just happens to be an instrumental.

jeffrey paradise on Looking Backwards, his own release note, 16 march 2026

in january 2025 he lost his home and studio in the los angeles fires. what came out of it was pull together, and a benefit show at aviator nation dreamland that march with diplo, SIDEPIECE, DRAMA and aluna, with the net proceeds going to musicares.

he toured for close to a decade as a six piece live band, at coachella, outside lands and primavera, and also plays dj sets, so check which one you are buying. in 2026: miami beach bandshell on 10 july, knoxville on 21 august, and both ojai and the ocean way festival in santa monica on 26 september.

James Hype

🚧 bumpy merseyside to london house

from a small town on the wirral, and in london since he moved there, by his own account, with fifty pounds in his pocket. what he is known for is the mixing itself rather than any one record, which is unusual at his size.

the records did the work first. More Than Friends in 2017 went platinum once and gold twice, No Drama with craig david followed in 2018, and Ferrari with miggy dela rosa in 2022 went to number one in the netherlands, italy and belgium. he says he made that one in a basement studio using pirated software.

You have to find the happiness and fulfillment in what you're doing every day.

james hype to edm.com, 29 june 2025

STEREOHYPE is his, a label and a clothing line, moving differently since 2019 per its own strapline, with r3wire, tita lau, zurra and dots per inch on it. his own 2026 has gone out through it, Trigger Finger in april and the Clubworld ep on 31 july.

the two live things are worth knowing about. SYNC is his own show format, where the gear is synced to custom lighting so the room can actually see the mixing happening, and it debuted at hï ibiza in 2025. OUR HOUSE is the party he runs with MEDUZA, further up this page, which has a no phones policy and is in its fourth season at hï, wednesdays from 27 may to 30 september.

the american dates are las vegas twice, zouk on 19 september and again on 24 october, then boo in seattle on the thirtieth.

Malaa

🚧 bumpy paris bass house

nobody knows who he is, and that is the point. he plays in a balaclava and has never confirmed a name. there are theories, all of them unverified, and this page is not going to add to them. an early press bio called him parisian, and he came up inside the pardon my french collective alongside dj snake and Tchami, further up this page.

spotify's own description of the music is the best short version going: stern if frequently humour laced bass house.

Notorious was the second record tchami ever put out on confession and it remains, ten years later, roughly forty times bigger than anything else with his name on it.

the album All In came out on 17 january 2025 with jeremih, apashe, vory and sonni across it. the more interesting move came a few months earlier, when he announced a rival version of himself. the alter ego is credited on releases as exactly that, and three of his five most played tracks now belong to it rather than to him, which is a strange and quite funny outcome.

No Redemption, the long running show he built with tchami, finished at edc las vegas in may 2025.

WAX MOTIF

🚧 bumpy australia to los angeles g house

Daniel Chien, australian born and los angeles based, with r&b, disco and uk bass all audible in what he makes. spotify credits him as a major orchestrator in developing the house sound across the united states, which is a big claim but not an unreasonable one.

the True Joy ep landed on mad decent in august 2015. the real turn was 2019, when he started Divided Souls Records and put everything through it after that, including the House of Wax album in february 2022 and its sequel on 8 may 2026.

he put the reason he keeps working with other people plainly.

When you go to the studio with someone, even if it's someone not as skilled as you or more skilled than you, you always pick up something new.

wax motif to dancing astronaut, 13 april 2022

House of Wax II proves the point. fourteen tracks with ty dolla $ign, dj jazzy jeff, camden cox, sarah de warren and ZHU on them, plus Run It Up made with Juos, who is further up this page. the two of them followed it with On Ya Neck on 26 june 2026. he also has history with Matroda, a joint remix of missy elliott's Lose Control in 2019 and La Candela Viva in july 2022.

his biggest record by a distance is still WET. this summer he plays celine in orlando on 14 august, breakaway mass at the palladium on the twenty first, and night we met in nashville on 12 september.

Lee Foss

🚧 bumpy chicago house + techno

from illinois and chicago based, with a nineties adolescence in that city doing most of the work on his taste. resident advisor files him under underground house and techno, and the influence list he gives runs chicago house, r&b, nineties hip hop, eighties electro and detroit techno.

in 2008 he and Jamie Jones founded Hot Creations, which is one of the two or three labels this whole page keeps circling back to. he entered resident advisor's top 100 djs at number thirty eight in 2010, the highest new entry that year, and was up to eleven by 2011. the two of them also record together as hot natured.

I consider myself a musician first, instead of a dj

lee foss to louche music

in 2018 he started Repopulate Mars, which dj mag named best breakthrough label that year, and it has become the home for a lot of what is on this page. JOSHWA's My Humps, made with foss, came out on it and is the biggest record either of them has. CID and joshwa put How We Do out there in 2022. he also made 1, 2 Step with SIDEPIECE that year and Free with a trak.

2026 has been a steady run on his own label, Smack That with polovich in january, Cult Of Bass in may and Party Monster in june, plus a remix of marshall jefferson's Move Your Body for helix in february.

Franky Rizardo

🚧 bumpy netherlands house

dutch, playing since at least 2007, and described by resident advisor as the most internationally booked dj the netherlands has. the sound, in their words, is deep and driving, blending groove, energy and emotion.

he runs two things. FLOW, a party started in 2015 that has grown into a touring brand across several cities, with a pacha ibiza residency lined up for summer 2026. and LTF Records, which his own bio says finished 2025 inside beatport's ten best selling house labels.

the other half of his year belongs to somebody else's party. he is a core member of Marco Carola's music on collective, further up this page, which puts him at pacha in ibiza, space in miami and reframe in los angeles.

The way AIR is set up allows for a close interaction and connection between crowd and DJ. This allows for a better feeling with the audience, which benefits the vibe.

franky rizardo to deep house amsterdam, 7 october 2016

his most played record is his remix of Make Me. everything he has put out in 2026 has gone through ltf: More To Life with carston in january, Zero Azucar in february, Shinjuku in march and Feel in june. earlier in the year he took the more to life concept to the ziggo dome in amsterdam and, per his own bio, sold it out to fifteen thousand people.

Dennis Cruz

🚧 bumpy madrid tech house

born in madrid in 1983, started djing at seventeen while studying sound engineering, and only began producing in 2010. resident advisor now calls him one of the pillars of the underground house and tech community.

2016 is when it happened. beatport made him its third best tech house artist that year and resident advisor its second most charted, off the back of several beatport number ones. the New Life ep on snatch! in may is the best marker of that run.

To be completely honest, I love being in the studio. It's not just my job but it's also my hobby.

dennis cruz to radio intense

he has released on hot creations, moon harbour, crosstown rebels, suara and glasgow underground, and he has been working with solid grooves since 2015. he founded Lemon-Aid Music and MÜSE, and co founded a creative agency called loud.

there has been a lot since mid 2025. No Sleep with joseph capriati on metamorfosi in june 2025, the Wacamama ep on botaniq that october, The Trip in april 2026 and Bubbling with patrick luna on solid grooves in june. Gorgon City, further up this page, remixed his Ahora Todo Va back in 2021, and both Jamie Jones and marco carola have played his records for years. his own biggest is El Sueño.

he is on the music on bill at pacha in ibiza this season.

Franky Wah

🧃 vibes doncaster melodic house + progressive

from the rural edge of doncaster in yorkshire. resident advisor's line is that he blends emotion, dance energy and catchy hooks, and magnetic's read on his recent work is deep house and techno with trance and breakbeat in it.

Come Together, out on ministry of sound on 3 april 2020, is the record that did it. his own bio says annie mac kept it on radio 1's a list for six weeks.

When I approach my performances, it's always about creating a journey. You've got to read the room, feel the energy.

franky wah to electronic groove, april 2025

he started SHÈN Recordings in 2022. the name means spirit in chinese and the label is tied to his own heritage. sasha, cristoph and joris voorn have all released on it, and it held a sixteen week ibiza residency in 2023 that has since moved to chinois.

this summer: nacar in barcelona on 8 august, creamfields on the twenty eighth, then blue marlin in ibiza on 27 september and the masquerade closing at chinois on 10 october.

J. Worra

🚧 bumpy chicago to los angeles tech house

Jamie Sitter found electronic music in chicago after college and has been in los angeles for years now. her own four word summary of the sound is classic house fused with modern tech.

I really just love to create and be able to share something with a greater audience. It's like I share a little bit of myself with every song I produce or set I play.

j. worra to magnetic magazine, 15 april 2019

the record that dwarfs everything else is Check Out, made with LP Giobbi and leo stannard in may 2022, which has more than ten times the plays of anything else she has released. she also has Cutting Loose with Disco Lines and anabel englund, and she has released on dirtybird, farris wheel, sweat it out, insomniac and gorgon city's REALM. four of those names are elsewhere on this page.

at the end of 2025 she started her own label, dialogxe, out of los angeles. its stated remit is house, tech house and club music, and the motto printed on its page is worth reading twice: music 4 dancing, no pitch deck, no manifesto, just records for the room.

the MUSIC 4 DANCING ep opened it in december 2025, Mirror Mirror with lena leon followed on insomniac in march 2026, and Adored came back to dialogxe on 1 july.

Mindchatter

🧃 vibes new york electronic + songwriting

Bryce Connolly, new york, and not a dj at all. he has no resident advisor page because there is nothing to book in a booth. what he does is a live show, and he has been building it out for years.

the project started in 2019 and the first album came out on ZHU's mind of a genius, further up this page. the same label put out the Westend remix of his Math in june 2022, which is how a lot of house listeners found him.

The most-valuable-instrument in this song (and probably all my songs) is a sampler. I grew up playing the drums so I always prefer smacking something over programming notes onto the grid.

mindchatter to magnetic magazine, 2 september 2020

the live rig now includes an electronic mallet controller, visuals time coded to the music and a vj who travels with him rather than whoever the venue provides. he sings, heavily processed. in 2024 he sold out a twenty three date north american tour and extended it past thirty five shows across five countries.

his recent run is all on maison arts. the Inner Democracy ep in october 2025, the album Giving Up On Words that november, and Soft Focus in february 2026. Drug In Us, from the album, is an original made with Poolside, also on this page. his most played track is still Kerosene.

colorado gets him on 25 september, at the dillon amphitheater supporting big wild. he played red rocks in november 2024 opening for of the trees.

ANOTR

either lane amsterdam house

Jesse van der Heijden and Oguzhan Guney, who goes by oz, met at a birthday party as young teenagers on the north side of amsterdam. jesse was already making music and oz wanted to understand how it worked, so they started doing it together. dj mag describes what came out of that as euphoric house and rolling tech house carrying jazz, funk and psychedelic influence, and the ibiza room that hosts their label night calls it groovy, minimal and genre fluid. that spread is why this page does not pin them to one lane.

It's a really strong community, some people come to our events three, four, five times a year. And every time we want to impress them.

anotr to dj mag

the record that carried them furthest is Talk To You with 54 ultra, which sat at number three on the uk official singles chart dated 24 july 2026 after twenty weeks on it. before that came Relax My Eyes with abel balder on 11 november 2022 and the debut album The Reset the same year. the third album, Withness, landed on 12 june 2026, twelve tracks built on classic drum machines and eighties tinted textures, with 3ddy across most of it and wayne snow and benny sings among the guests.

they started NO ART in 2018 and it has never been only a label. dj mag calls it a label, collective, fashion line and family unit. the bandcamp page states the thinking plainly: when there are so many different sounds and techniques at one's disposal, it's a waste to repeat what's already done. the roster stays small, with makèz and mateo dufour alongside the duo, and the parties grew out of a debut festival at ndsm werf in july 2022.

on 17 and 18 september 2026 they play alexandra palace in london, two nights promoted by labyrinth and billed by the venue as their biggest uk headline show to date, the second added after the first sold out. a NO ART night follows at unvrs in ibiza on 29 september 2026 with Prospa, toman and miluhska. on 13 november 2026 they play playa pacha at five luxe jbr in dubai as part of the pacha icons series.

Dennis Quin

🚧 bumpy amsterdam house

dennis quin bought his first vinyl in amsterdam in 1992, riding his bike to the shop in the years when the city's distribution scene was pulling in the best of the uk and the us. he was too young for roxy, but the nights he spent at club it between 1994 and 1999 are what he points at when asked where his sound came from. he teaches at the herman brood academy alongside the touring, and beatport files him under bass driven house that moves between tech house and deep house.

If I had to choose, I prioritise the drums. I worked more than 12 years to get my drums and kicks sounding the way they do now.

dennis quin to undrtone, 10 april 2025

the record that travelled furthest is You Are In My System, his rework with kerri chandler and troy denari, out on kaoz theory on 15 september 2023. he built it for his own sets from an acapella troy denari handed him around 2017, rewrote the drums and bassline around it inside two weeks, and only put it out after kerri chandler started playing it next to the original. he has also released through defected, solid grooves, piv and you&me records, and in february 2026 he took The Mindshaker ep to heavy house society, the label run by Sidney Charles. he has said he sends finished tracks to a small circle for feedback before they go anywhere, and named Chris Stussy among the people he trusts with that.

he opened EARDRUMS in amsterdam with The Liberation ep on 13 june 2025, after testing the idea on a smaller imprint called dq music. the label page keeps its promise to one line: timeless house music influenced by the uk, the us and the netherlands, no hype, just pure quality. Rock & Rule ep followed on 17 october 2025 on vinyl and digital. he also runs QuINvites, a party series built on expected and unexpected b2b and b3b sets, which ran five editions in the netherlands before its london debut at xoyo on 19 april 2025.

he plays both nights of you&me at depot mayfield in manchester, josh baker's showcase inside the warehouse project season, on friday 2 october 2026 and saturday 3 october 2026. the friday bill also carries Josh Baker, Prospa, Carlita, Julian Fijma, Marsolo and Stef Davidse. the saturday adds Dennis Cruz, Seth Troxler, Sidney Charles, Jamback, M-High and Job de Jong. resident advisor also lists him at xoyo in london on 19 september 2026 and at maassilo in rotterdam on 31 october 2026.

Estiva

🧃 vibes the netherlands progressive house

Steven Baan launched estiva in 2007 and has not stopped since, first through enhanced recordings, anjunabeats and armada, which is a trance and progressive lineage rather than a club house one. he has been a colorize regular since 2017, putting out originals and remixes and curating the label's colorscapes compilation series.

I was 16 or 17 when I came up with it and its just my name Steve, Steven, Estiva.

estiva to edmli, 21 april 2025

Infinita, his fourth album, arrived on colorize on 9 june 2023 with jess ball, julia church, cosmosky, diana miro and rbbts across it, and pushed harder into progressive house and techno than anything before it. Embrace, the fifth, followed on 25 april 2025, fourteen tracks with liz cass and gaalia among the voices, teased ahead of release by Sudden Moves, Parlez-Vous, Lonely Keys and KFIL.

the run through 2026 has been steady and all of it on colorize. Via Balearia came on 10 june, Palma on 8 july, and the Solyra ep is due on 5 august. he also runs his own label, Potentially Dreaming, started in 2022, which his site describes as a liminal space where boundaries between realities and vivid dreams blur.

Horse Meat Disco

🧃 vibes london disco and nu-disco

horse meat disco is four djs and a sunday night. luke howard, severino panzetta, james hillard and jim stanton started the party on new year's day 2004 at the eagle in vauxhall, south london, and it still runs there every sunday. it was built as a queer party, a room where the record came first and everybody was welcome, and that has been the point of it ever since. their own line on how the night works is worth keeping: you put music at the top and getting high or jiggy follows, not the other way round.

In 15 odd years of doing this now there has never been an argument. We're all pretty easy going.

james hillard to glitterbox, 1 october 2020

the records grew out of the party rather than the other way round. strut released the first Horse Meat Disco compilation on 1 january 2009, a set of silky anthems and sleaze classics pulled from what the four of them were actually playing, and the series ran to a fourth volume on 1 january 2014. they held a weekly sunday show on rinse fm and played radio 1's essential mix on 23 december 2017. in 2009 they built glastonbury's first dedicated LGBTQ+ space, and they have carried the sunday format out to residencies in berlin and new york.

the album is Love And Dancing, out on glitterbox recordings on 2 october 2020. fourteen tracks, seven years of work, all original writing with no covers and no samples, made alongside luke solomon and keyboard player darren morris. kathy sledge of sister sledge sings on two of them, amy douglas on three, and n'dea davenport takes Fight For Love. it is the record that moved them from selectors to a group that writes disco.

the remix work has kept coming. Disco & Boogie From Brazil Vol.1, a thirteen track compilation they assembled for mr bongo with rio record collector tee cardaci, arrived on 21 march 2025. their rework of nile rodgers and duran duran's Free to Love came out on tape modern on 22 may 2026, the lykke li remix Lucky Again followed on 10 july 2026, and their take on jessie ware's Sauna landed on EMI on 17 july 2026.

Job de Jong

🚧 bumpy leiden, netherlands house and tech house

job de jong is based in leiden and works out of the amsterdam house scene. he started his career in 2019 and the sound has not wandered far since. 90s house bones, big basslines, raw drum loops and a melody you can still hum on the way home. his own listed influences are kerri chandler, todd terry and green cloud, which tells you most of what you need to know before you press play.

his first record for PIV was the Enchanted ep on 24 march 2023, four originals plus a folamour remix of the title track. after that he spread out across labels. Dub House landed on reliance on 25 april 2025 and picked up a kepler remix, Take One came out on tszr, three six zero recordings, on 1 august 2025, and The Message ep arrived on Josh Baker's you&me records on 12 september 2025. talman, locus, hardline and airtime have all had records from him too.

2026 has been steady rather than showy. Deep Inside with kepler came out on contact music on 24 april, Get On Up with michel de hey on haven trax on 26 june, Selecta on gettraum on 3 july, and the Link Up ep went back to haven trax on 10 july.

he plays both nights of you&me at the warehouse project, friday 2 october 2026 and saturday 3 october 2026, both at depot mayfield in manchester and both sold out. Josh Baker tops each night. friday puts him alongside Prospa, Carlita, Julian Fijma, Marsolo, Stef Davidse and Dennis Quin. saturday adds M-High, Dennis Cruz, Seth Troxler, Sidney Charles and Jamback.

monkey safari are two brothers, lars and sven, out of halle in eastern germany. they have been at this a long time. they ran a label called what! what! from 2008, the act's name came from a friend during a studio session in kreuzberg, berlin, and the club they are tied to in halle is charles bronson, named after the american actor. their own stated remit is about as unambiguous as remits get, send sunny vibes to make even the darkest dance floors smile.

We are both very positive-minded people, and we try to bring that into both our productions and our sets.

the record that opened the door was High Life, made in the summer of 2012, put out by monaberry in september 2012 and picked up by ministry of sound after Pete Tong played it on his radio show. albums followed, Odyssey in 2017, HI in 2019 and Love Will Set U Free in 2021. the track that travels furthest is Safe on their own Hommage, or rather joris voorn's remix of it, which outruns everything else under their name.

the remix column is where the bigger rooms found them. they took Always for RÜFÜS DU SOL, out on rose avenue and reprise on 12 august 2022 as part of the surrender remixes, and they have also remixed booka shade and röyksopp. get physical has been a steady home, with the Kami EP in 2022 and Vive with g.zamora on 7 february 2025. after roughly a decade of Hommage they moved the operation onto a new imprint, Good Vibes From Paradise, and that is where the 2026 run sits. Otherside with awen came out on 24 april 2026, Okonokwa on 29 may 2026, Hail From Mali with nenahalena on 26 june 2026 and Future on 31 july 2026.

Emmit Fenn

berkeley to los angeles indie electronic

he is not a house or techno artist and this page will not pretend he is. emmit fenn writes songs, sings them and produces them himself, and the results land closer to alt pop than to any dancefloor. he is here because dance producers keep turning up in his credits, and because one of those records went straight into this scene.

I make electronic music, or that's what they have categorized me as, but I kind of make everything

emmit fenn to detour, 17 july 2017

he grew up in berkeley, california and started making music at twelve after finding a keyboard in a friend's garage. in 2013, straight out of high school, a friend showed him logic and he went into production from there. he dropped out of college, signed to th3rd brain, and the label still puts his records out.

the dance connection is specific rather than vague. Closer, made with Adriatique, came out on x recordings on 3 april 2026. rebūke, vxsion and christian löffler have all remixed The Chase, and he has done remix work for kygo. he is credited as a writer on billie eilish's bitches broken hearts, which the riaa certified gold on 12 december 2019.

his own catalogue runs long and stays independent. Prologue arrived in 2017 after Painting Greys went round in 2015. then Far From Here in 2021, The Last Dance, Pt 2 in 2022, How To Fly On The Ground in 2023 and The Last Dance, Pt 3 in 2025. Threads came out on th3rd brain on 16 january 2026 and Lungs followed on 22 may 2026.

two august 2026 dates are confirmed from the venues themselves. celebrities nightclub in vancouver on 8 august, nineteen and over, ten until four. then big night live in boston on 15 august, twenty one and over, doors at eleven. both are billed under his own name with no support announced.

Félix

🚧 bumpy uk and spain deep tech

félix is a british producer who splits his time between the uk and spain, with london as the home base. every bio on every channel he controls leads with the words self taught, and the release history backs it up, because the early records went out on small labels with nobody obvious behind them.

the first thing under the name landed on miaw on 30 march 2020, a two tracker carrying Bella Ciao and MinAnimal. The Serenade followed on andhera records on 20 may 2022. two months after that he made his kaluki musik debut with the Stand Up EP on 15 july 2022, credited then as felixo, which is how beatport still bills those two tracks.

the do not sleep connection came on 24 may 2024 with the Drop The Bass EP, three tracks deep, Colombia and Brazil Beat sitting either side of the title cut. between those two he had put Jungle Fire out on libero records on 9 february 2023, and 2 STEP arrived later on give soul records on 30 may 2025.

the biggest one is BAIANÁ, cut with the brazilian body percussion group barbatuques and released on helix records on 7 november 2025. he also has an official remix of mk's Dior to his name, and a remix of Por La Pandilla that went out on libero records on 27 march 2025.

he runs his own label and party, Offski Records, which put Dance Till You're Dead and Selecta out on 1 december 2023. bookings run through the same operation rather than through an agency.

one date is confirmed for 2026. he plays accused at eden in ibiza on sunday 23 august, on a bill with reelow, sam marzi, jamie fielding, ramin rezaie, aca and james cooper. nothing else is published on his resident advisor page and he does not run a tour page of his own.

Infected Mushroom

🚧 bumpy israel to los angeles psytrance

psytrance is not house and it is not techno, so infected mushroom sit off to one side of this page. they hold the spot on force and craft. Erez Eisen and Amit Duvdevani teamed up in israel in 1996 and put out their first album in 1999. the duo works out of los angeles.

Technology has changed immensely and we've always been into it. We're very savvy and it's important for us to be.

infected mushroom to rolling stone india, 31 january 2017

the album run is long. The Gathering arrived in 1999, Classical Mushroom in 2000, Converting Vegetarians in 2003, Vicious Delicious in 2007, Legend of the Black Shawarma in 2009, Army of Mushrooms in 2012 and Return to the Sauce in 2017. the anniversary records went to monstercat, IM25 in 2022 and IM30 on 30 january 2026, eight tracks with bliss guesting on LA Beast.

they reached number nine in dj mag's top 100 djs poll in 2007. they also build their own production plugins, and polyverse music carries them as a featured artist.

the live show runs on psychedelic visuals and a heavy stage build. dates for 2026 include summer contrast festival in poland on 4 august, sentrum scene in oslo on 18 september, alte kaserne in zurich on 19 september and dream nation festival's halloween edition at parc des expositions paris nord on 30 october.

Jonas Blue

Guy Robin writes pop records first. jonas blue built the name on radio dance-pop rather than club house, which puts him at the edge of what this page usually covers, and his 2026 run on defected has walked him back toward the middle of it.

My strong point is writing great pop songs.

jonas blue to paper magazine, 20 may 2026

the official charts company credits him with four uk top ten singles. Fast Car with dakota and Perfect Strangers with jp cooper both peaked at number two in 2016, Mama with william singe reached number four in 2017 and Rise with jack and jack reached number three in 2018. By Your Side with raye stopped at fifteen in 2016 and Polaroid at twelve in 2018. Ritual with Tiësto and rita ora reached twenty four in 2019, and his album Blue peaked at thirty three in 2018. nothing under his name has topped either uk chart. in the usa the riaa lists Fast Car as platinum, certified on 9 june 2017.

most of the catalogue sits on positiva, with runs on virgin, emi, ultra and defected. Girl landed on defected on 29 may 2026, a four to the floor house record hung on a guitar hook. he told paper that defected has been with him since he was eighteen.

defected put him on the drumsheds bill in london on 19 september 2026 next to Armand Van Helden and Eats Everything. resident advisor lists him across august and september 2026 on MEDUZA and James Hype's our house nights at hï ibiza. on 19 december 2026 he is the named act on los40 dance's sixth anniversary show at plaza de toros de las ventas in madrid, a spanish radio station bill rather than a solo show of his own.

Kolter

Johannes Kolter makes house, breaks and most things sitting between them, out of cologne. he released under the name djoko first and moved to his own family name in 2023, which is where this project properly starts.

kolter to mixmag brasil, 6 march 2023

with Sidney Charles he has a real running partnership. manda moor is danish and filipino, grew up in france and works out of paris. she played her first big shows in 2019 and got serious about producing the same year.

I definitely got the music bug from my mother. She was a singer.

manda moor to gray area

a trip to chicago in 2019 set the direction. she met dj pierre, dj sneak, dj deeon and k'alexi there, and the 90s chicago house she took from that runs through most of what she has made since. she remixed the ron hardy memo for heattraxx on 14 june 2024 and has released on dj pierre's afro acid.

Marco Strous

the first break came in 2017. a track of his called Persistence got passed along to cr2 records and signed on the spot, and it turned up on the label's best of cr2 2017 compilation on 15 december that year.

I like to think of the track as a pep talk which you can dance to!

marco strous to dbs institute, 7 october 2017

the run since has been steady rather than loud. Rain Dance and Good Boy came out on revival new york on 16 september 2022. 2026 stepped things up. Professor X, cut with rusko, arrived on black book records on 20 march, and a remix of quiero verte bailar built together with Chris Lake came out on primavera labels on 26 may.

Mikey Lion

either lane san diego house and techno

mikey lion is a dj and producer from san diego and the most visible face of desert hearts, the crew he helped start. his ra biography has him behind the decks at thirteen, scratching hip hop records after school, then switching to house the day after he saw daft punk at coachella at seventeen. he also put in a stretch of long dj sessions at sala razzmatazz in barcelona before any of the desert hearts story began.

I don't really think of it like I'm running one of the biggest brands in America because to me it still feels like we're just getting started.

mikey lion to magnetic magazine, 20 october 2021

the crew formed at burning man in 2011, when he joined up with his brother porkchop, longtime friends marbs and deep jesus, and lee reynolds. the first desert hearts ran in november 2012 as a two hundred person renegade gathering in the mojave desert. the brand describes itself as a tribute to house, techno and love, and it runs two labels, Desert Hearts Records from 2014 and the heavier Desert Hearts Black.

his own records mostly land on the house label and mostly credit the crew alongside him. Good Times came out 3 may 2024. the California ep followed on 29 april 2026 with marbs and lee reynolds, two tracks, california and dancing feet. A Place For Us, made with marbs, landed 30 july 2026.

the run into summer 2026 was festival work. dirtybird campout x northern nights at cooks valley campground on 17 july 2026, love long beach festival at shoreline aquatic park on 18 july 2026, and groove & bass festival in quebec city on 23 july 2026. as of 2 august 2026 his ra page lists nothing after that, so there are no confirmed bookings to point at.

kevin mckay to clash, 5 january 2018

the label stopped in 2004 and he has been blunt about why, telling beatportal that he had pitched it at too narrow a deep house audience and that by the early 2000s british clubbers had started calling that sound dad house. the gap years went into other work, including production on mylo's album Destroy Rock & Roll and the heartbeats label he set up in 2007 to release grum. glasgow underground came back in 2011.

martin ikin was born in liverpool, raised in london, and has been making records since 1991. he was seventeen when the first one, damage, went out on basement records under the name dj mayhem. the training came first though. he is a fully qualified studio engineer and a jazz pianist who led jazz funk bands, and he still does session work and teaches piano.

he spent years under other names, soul purpose, indigo and migrant among them, and in 2003 he started Soul Purpose Records as a home for his own productions. it drew in vocalists including juliet roberts, elisabeth troy and angie brown. in 2005 he retired the mayhem tag and began releasing under his own name for the first time.

Mike Dunn

either lane englewood, chicago chicago house

mike dunn started djing around 1983 in englewood, on the south side of chicago, working park district parties and house parties with two reel to reels running alongside the turntables. his first record, Dance You Mutha, came out in 1987 on westbrook records. in the same years he was engineering sessions for marshall jefferson and armando, which is how a lot of the first wave of chicago house actually got made.

on 18 march 2026 the city of chicago honoured him at daley plaza, adopting a resolution for a body of work that by then covered close to forty years. 5 magazine covered the ceremony.

It's a beautiful thing to come from nothing and be something

mike dunn to 5 magazine, 6 april 2026

the alias that travels furthest is MD X-Spress. God Made Me Phunky arrived under that name in 1994 and never went away, and defected put out a remix package of it on 14 may 2021 with versions from Eats Everything, harry romero and the vision. the spoken word delivery on it is the thing people copy and cannot quite land.

My House From All Angles followed on 1 december 2017, his first album since 1990, released through moreaboutmusic and his own Blackball Muzik. defected gave him a volume of its house masters series in 2020. glitterbox recordings has been the other steady home, and Strut Cho Phunky Stuff (Sho' Nuff) landed there on 12 march 2021.

he founded Dance Mutha in 1988 and restarted it in 2024, opening with the Tracks From The Beginning Vol.1 ep on 5 july 2024, built from tapes he recovered from the late eighties. Acid Madness followed on the label on 30 may 2025. his voice fronts Bump, credited to the brothers macklovitch, Tony Romera and a-trak, out 24 october 2025. most recent is Phunky, a rework built with ahmed spins for DFTD on 24 july 2026.

Giuseppe Di Stasi is from canosa di puglia, in the puglia region of southern italy, and works out of bari. before any of this paid, he was doing twelve hour days in a shoe factory. royalties from a 2015 record called Alive built the first home studio, and the studio moved with him from canosa to bari as the work grew.

the record that opened doors was Disco Connection, out on glitterbox recordings on 29 september 2017. it is still the clearest statement of what he does, which is warm, filtered, disco-leaning house with the low end sitting where a tech house producer would put it.

the most recent full body of work is House Propaganda, a seven track album on umani wax released on 5 june 2026, running from tech house at the top through to straighter vocal house. he has also had a busy remix year across 2026, including a DFTD accapella package built from U R in may 2026.

one confirmed booking ahead. he plays defected gioia tauro at the vulcano beach club on 14 august 2026, on a bill with andrea oliva, nic fanciulli and overgivelse, listed on defected's own events calendar.

Shermanology

either lane the netherlands and curaçao soulful house to tech house

Andy Sherman and Dorothy Sherman are brother and sister, which is rare enough in house music, and they have been one act for a long time. they moved to curaçao at the ages of twelve and fourteen. before shermanology existed they were singing backing vocals together, and at fifteen and seventeen they started an r&b group with a cousin called triple s.

the industry found them as guest vocalists first. by 2011 they were singing on big dutch dance records, including afrojack's Can't Stop Me, and that is how most people heard the name.

Everything we do is based on feeling. Our production, songwriting, harmonies, it's all done by ear. It might not always be technically perfect, but it has to feel good.

shermanology to mixmag caribbean, 21 july 2026

dorothy's voice is the thing the whole project is built around. it is what separates them from every producer duo working the same tempo, and it is why a shermanology record can go soulful or go hard without sounding like two different acts.

in april 2021 they launched their own label, D'EAUPE. Boyz N Da Club landed on it that same month, on 30 april 2021, and annie mac gave it hottest record in the world on BBC radio 1. the label has carried most of their output since.

the two records that travel furthest are collaborations. It's A Killa, made with FISHER for his catch & release label, came out on 11 march 2022. Hotter, cut with Green Velvet for nervous records, followed on 4 july 2025.

summer 2026 keeps them moving. they play defected's thursday residency at chinois in ibiza on 20 august 2026, alongside d stone, eliza rose, kilimanjaro and lloyd nwagboso. on 12 september 2026 they are on the bill at a day at the park in the kralingse bos in rotterdam. JGit

🚧 bumpy home town not published afro house to tech house

jgit is a producer with four records out and no published home town. he does not list a city on beatport, on soundcloud or on any of his release pages, so the music is all there is to go on. that turns out to be enough.

four releases, four different labels, and four different beatport genres. that is a wide spread for a catalogue this size, and it is the thing that makes him worth watching.

it starts with Pa-pa-pa-Pa on mustache crew records in july 2025, filed as afro house at 121 bpm. Indicate came four months later on AK Cartel in november 2025, straight house at 122.

We Are Better turned up on the anchor records in january 2026 and beatport calls it indie dance, at 124 bpm. then Follow Me, made with dub pepper for ULTIMA in may 2026, lands as tech house at 125.

read those in order and the tempo climbs one notch at a time, 121 to 122 to 124 to 125, while the genre tag changes underneath it every single time. his beatport page is the one place all four sit together.

no upcoming dates are published for him. he has no resident advisor profile, and neither beatport nor soundcloud lists a booking.

Bákayan

bákayan was born and raised in a small town in bavaria, in a home his parents built after leaving istanbul. turkish folk music and german life sat next to each other in that house, and he has told mixmag turkey how much of that first music is still in what he writes. in 2018 he moved to berlin.

he is a producer, a dj and a live vocalist, and the third one is what makes the set his. he sings over his own tracks instead of only mixing them. underneath the voice is organic house, hand percussion, long melodic builds and a lot of air.

I see music as a way to process and communicate experiences that can't always be put into words.

echonomist grew up in thessaloniki, and the whole thing starts with a synthesizer his family bought him as a child. before the alias he fronted a downtempo project called IνΦο that put out three albums by 2009.

in 2025 he started Flying Hearts with jenia tarsol. it opened with The Harbour, a rework of a song by the uk band Throws from their 2016 album, and the pair set it up so every release would come paired with an artist portrait.

he keeps good company on a bill. on 20 june 2026 he played a live set at carroponte in milan on a mind against night alongside Adriatique.

It's important to remind yourself that you exist even when the music stops.

echonomist to magnetic magazine, 20 may 2025

two dates are up next and both are on sale. he plays MODULE in copenhagen on 11 september 2026 in a two till four in the morning slot, then house of yes in brooklyn on 19 september 2026 with OVEOUS.

Hannes Bieger

🚧 bumpy berlin, germany melodic techno

hannes bieger made his name behind the desk before he made it in front of one. he spent about eleven years on mixing and mastering work out of berlin, which is still where he lives and works.

the turn came in 2017. a moog modular bought the year before pulled him back toward writing his own material, and his debut ep landed on poker flat that same year. bedrock, flying circus, hommage and awesome soundwave, the label carl cox runs with christopher coe, all followed.

in 2024 he set up Elektrons as an outlet of his own. it opened with Black Hole on 29 march 2024.

not all of the writing happens in the studio. the Playa Perdida EP for bedrock started somewhere else entirely.

I actually wrote my latest Bedrock EP, Playa Perdida, on a deserted volcanic beach in Bali.

hannes bieger to magnetic magazine, 28 may 2025

no upcoming dates are published for him. as of 2 august 2026 his resident advisor page carried nothing dated later than august 2025, and his own link hub listed only shows and masterclasses that have already happened.

Moon Boots

🧃 vibes brooklyn, new york nu-disco and house

Pete Dougherty makes house and nu-disco as moon boots. he was born in brooklyn, spent seven years in chicago after college and then came back to brooklyn.

his first records went out on french express, a us imprint whose catalogue ran from 2010 to 2018. the Off My Mind EP landed there in 2011, Got Somebody and Sugar in 2012, No One and Love Strong in 2013. edm.com reported in august 2017 that anjunadeep found him through those french express records and that the two sides started working together in 2013.

three albums followed on anjunadeep. First Landing on 4 august 2017, Bimini Road on 6 september 2019 and Ride Away on 17 march 2023. he told dancing astronaut in september 2019 what he liked most about the second one.

I'm really happy with it. One of the things that's really been the most rewarding to me has been seeing how people are latching onto different songs.

moon boots to dancing astronaut, 27 september 2019

the chicago years still turn up in the work. writing about Reach The Stars for magnetic magazine in october 2020 he called the track an homage to chicago house and named paul johnson, derrick carter and cajmere / Green Velvet.

the singles have kept coming since the albums. Hold Me Tight on forever days on 21 march 2025, Sunshine with lyric jones on fool's gold records on 9 may 2025, his remix of Es Pa Ti for brandon markell holmes and robert pm on toucan sounds on 20 march 2026, and Get On Up with pinto on jackies music records on 24 april 2026. he also turns up on yung bae's PARTY NEVER STOPS, out 23 january 2026.

no upcoming dates are published. the tour page on his own site carries the heading and nothing under it, and his resident advisor page lists only shows already played, the most recent of them at crobar in cleveland on 25 july 2026.

Nico de Andrea

either lane france melodic and afro house

nico de andrea is french. he came up as a dj and took up production after that, and his records still sound like they were built by somebody who has to move a room at 2am.

the record that sits at the top of his spotify page is Wish We Could, cut with syon and darla jade. the original mix landed on headroom records on 29 may 2020 and the extended went out through unity records the same day, with a THEMBA remix following on 12 june 2020. it is the deep, patient, vocal-led end of what he does.

For me, it has always been a challenge to blend the soulful tracks that introduced me to music, like Sade, Stevie Wonder, or Jamiroquai, with club music.

nico de andrea to magnetic magazine, 13 february 2024

armada music has been his home since 2022. the album Love Therapy arrived there on 26 january 2024, written around piano and pointed at pop songwriting as much as at the floor, with tensnake, julia church and eli & fur among the guests. a deluxe edition followed later in 2024.

he made Let Me Love You with LP Giobbi for headroom records in october 2021. Franky Wah remixed Disappear, his record with THEMBA and tasan, for armada music in 2023. going the other way, he has remixed CamelPhat and nadia ali's Endlessly and MEDUZA and HAYLA's Another World.

the 2026 run is wide. River with ARA on armada music on 24 april 2026, then Bring The Noise 2026 alongside public enemy and austin millz on def jam recordings on 12 june 2026, then Give Me Love with cerrone on armada music on 19 june 2026. beatport files that middle one under tech house, which tells you how far he will push when the record asks for it.

no upcoming dates are published. his most recent listed booking is 19 june 2026 at the roof at superior ingredients in brooklyn, and there is nothing on the books after it.

Roman Flügel

either lane darmstadt, germany house, techno and ambient

roman flügel has been putting out records since the early 1990s, and the width of the catalogue is the point rather than any one lane. house, techno, electro, acid and ambient all live in it, often inside the same twelve months.

the labels came early. with jörn elling wuttke he co-founded Ongaku, Klang Elektronik and Playhouse. the pair also recorded together as the primitive painter, and their self-titled 1994 album was pressed in a run of 500 and credited to klang elektronik by mistake, before it was put back into print in 2020.

he opened an imprint under his own hand in 2020. Sister Midnight started with Tracks On Delivery, a triple vinyl that gathered fifteen patterns first issued through ongaku between 2000 and 2002, plus two that had never come out.

elsewhere he has kept steady homes. the 2021 album Eating Darkness and the Anima ep went to running back, the label gerd janson runs, and erol alkan's phantasy announced Hotel Karthago / Energies and the No Solutions EP in 2024.

the 2026 diary is busy and it travels. paradigm festival in groningen on 8 august 2026 and RALLY in southwark park in london on 29 august 2026 both take tracks on delivery as a live show. he also plays silencio in paris on 21 august 2026, the club room at hï ibiza on 11 september 2026 for a CamelPhat presents summer of love night, public records in brooklyn on 11 october 2026 with frank & tony, and GASHOUDER in amsterdam on 18 november 2026, where his HARMONY slot is an ambient live set inside sven väth's inner horizon programme.

Stavroz

🧃 vibes ghent, belgium organic and downtempo house

stavroz is a belgian band that plays live, not a solo dj. resident advisor and electronic groove both date the start to 2011, when IJsbrand De Wilde and Gert Beazar started working together as djs and sound engineers. Maxim Helincks and Pieter De Meester came in afterwards for the live show and the studio. they work out of ghent.

the record that sits at the top of their spotify page is The Finishing. it arrived on The Ginning, a six track release on délicieuse records dated 28 september 2015. the Gold Town EP followed on moodfamily on 26 may 2017, and their kindisch material runs through 2015 and 2016.

Kick Up The Dust came out under stavroz sounds on 1 september 2023. then the album Take a Seat, fourteen tracks with RY X on Lilac, landed on moodfamily on 17 october 2025. they told decoded magazine that month that they had changed their usual way of working for it, writing together rather than shaping ideas separately in four home studios.

the live setup is the thing they keep circling back to.

What we enjoy about playing live is how dependent we are on one another. If one link in the system is unavailable, the show doesn't work. That makes it challenging, but also very rewarding.

stavroz to electronic groove, 23 may 2019

2026 keeps them on festival stages. summer contrast festival at rogalino in świdwin, poland runs 4 to 10 august 2026, with stavroz billed as a live set on a bill that also carries Monolink and Infected Mushroom. hangar's beach party at kh summercamp in knokke-heist, belgium follows on 8 august 2026 alongside colyn. then tsoa's tenth anniversary at seaseaclub in barcelona on 3 october 2026, with patrice bäumel and marino canal. tickets are on sale for all three. no colorado date is published.

the hot creations debut arrived on 26 june 2026. the F To This Beat ep carries the title track and BodyLang, both cut for function rather than fireworks.

So I think the best way to honor the artists who came before us is to play and create music that pushes new ideas, new sonics, and new directions, because that is what has always kept electronic music evolving.

balanka to magnetic magazine, 8 july 2026

oden & fatzo make house music out of paris, moving between house, minimal and hip-hop rather than settling into one lane. genre works as a tool for the pair, not a rule, and that shows up across a catalogue running from stripped-back minimal cuts to vocal-led house records.

their most pivotal record is Lauren, released in 2021. it opened up international touring for the duo.

Lauren was the turning point in our career. it's the track that changed everything for us and gave us the chance to travel the world together as friends.

earlier tracks like Super Mega Robot Dinosaur and OB1 Kenobi mapped out the shift, moving from early sound-synthesis experiments toward the warmer, detroit-leaning house that followed.

Audio Bullys

either lane london, united kingdom house

Simon Franks and Tom Dinsdale formed audio bullys in london in 2003. dinsdale learned to dj as a teenager, buying hardcore, jungle and drum and bass records from slammin' vinyl in kingston.

when I was 15, I used to go round to a family friend's house on my way home from school so I could learn how to dj.

tom dinsdale to decoded magazine, 28 september 2023

their debut album, Ego War, came out in 2003 and reached number 19 on the uk albums chart. its lead single, We Don't Care, reached number 15 on the uk singles chart in january of that year.

their best charting single is Shot You Down, featuring nancy sinatra, which reached number 3 on the uk singles chart in 2005, the same year their second album, Generation, reached number 33 on the uk albums chart.

after a long gap, the duo returned in september 2023 with As We Step, built around a re-recorded franks vocal over a sample of a 1991 rave record. since then they have shown up as guest vocalists on other producers' tracks, including Different Side with Michael Bibi and kinahau in 2023, and London's On Fire with Chris Lorenzo and Max Styler in 2025.

Axwell

axwell is a swedish dj and producer who came up through the swedish house underground in the early 2000s. in 2005 he started Axtone Records as an outlet for his own material, and the label has grown into a home for other producers as well.

VOLAC

🚧 bumpy moscow, russia bass house

VOLAC is a moscow duo built around heavy house with rolling, chest deep bass. dancing astronaut has called them a russian pair since at least 2016. their tracks favor thick low end and chopped vocal hooks, with a groove that leans into tech house.

early releases landed on night bass, the g-house label run by AC slater, and on CUFF. in 2019 they teamed with dr. fresch for Filthy, a house cut with dread MC on the mic, released on tchami's confession.

they opened 2020 with Baby Boy on musical freedom, tiësto's label. between 2023 and 2025 they returned repeatedly to repopulate mars.

since september 2025, most of their releases have come through myth of NYX, including Like Ice, out 22 may 2026.

no upcoming shows are listed on their own site or on the platforms checked, as of 3 august 2026.

Alok

either lane brazil brazilian bass

Alok Achkar Peres Petrillo was born in goiânia, brazil, on 26 august 1991. he started deejaying in 2004, at age 12, alongside his twin brother bhaskar, before moving to a solo career at 19.

on this roster he sits closer to pop than most, with a run of collaborations that cross from house into mainstream radio. in 2019 he co-founded Controversia with spinnin' records, a label built around brazilian bass and dance-pop crossovers that still releases compilations under his name.

the record that travelled furthest is Hear Me Now, made with bruno martini and featuring zeeba, released in 2016. on the uk's officialcharts.com, it peaked at number 8 on the official independent singles breakers chart in january 2017, then reached number 33 on the official independent singles chart in february 2017.

in 2021, he and Vintage Culture reworked oxia's early 2000s techno track Domino for his controversia label, adding new bass and synth parts for a festival-ready rebuild.

he has an ibiza residency running through 2026. on 5 august he joins the tomorrowland and dimitri vegas & like mike night at ushuaïa, then plays namaste at akasha las dalias the same night, and on 13 august he is booked into medusa festival in valencia, spain, with all three dates on sale.
